abstract: Provided is a multi-legged robot gait control method, comprising: dividing each gait of a robot into a plurality of action units having a pre-set order, acquiring a foot end motion trajectory of the robot and a target zero moment point corresponding thereto; where the robot is walking with a pre-set gait, according to a current zero moment point acquired in real time and the target zero moment point, obtaining a centre of mass motion trajectory of the robot; according to the foot end motion trajectory and the centre of mass motion trajectory, determining trajectory information about a component connection point of the robot; and controlling the robot to move in the order of the action units in a pre-set gait and according to the trajectory information about the component connection points corresponding to the action units. The method above solves the problem of using an offline design to plan the travel of a bi-legged robot, which causes poor anti-interference performance, and realizes the technical effect of real-time planning of a robot gait. Further provided are a multi-legged robot gait control apparatus, and a robot.
source_title: MULTI-LEGGED ROBOT GAIT CONTROL METHOD AND APPARATUS, AND ROBOT

abstract: Embodiments of the invention disclose a method and apparatus for motion transition of a multi-legged robot. The method includes the steps of judging whether a multi-legged robot enters a terrain transition phase according to landing conditions of swing leg ends of the multi-legged robot and a change condition of a body posture, the terrain transition phase including a transition phase from a flatterrain to a sloped terrain and a transition phase from the sloped terrain to the flat terrain; if so, adjusting motion planning paths of the swing leg ends; judging whether the multi-legged robot hasleft the terrain transition phase completely according to whether the forward distance of the center of mass of the body of the multi-legged robot is greater than the length of the body; and if so, adjusting the height of the multiple leg ends of the multi-legged robot relative to the plane of the body to the same height. The technical scheme of the embodiments of the invention can reduce the technical complexity and cost, and simply realizes the smooth and stable motion transition of the multi-legged robot between the flat terrain and the sloped terrain.
source_title: Method and apparatus for motion transition of multi-legged robot

abstract: The invention discloses a compact mining whole-body power-assisted exoskeleton robot with an anti-explosion shell and a posture monitoring function, and relates to the technical field of operation robots, the compact mining whole-body power-assisted exoskeleton robot comprises a trunk wearing assembly, two driving upper limb assemblies, two driving lower limb assemblies, a flexible connecting frame and a posture detection assembly; the two upper limb driving assemblies are connected with the trunk wearing assembly, and shoulder supporting structures are installed at the positions, close to the trunk wearing assembly, of the two upper limb driving assemblies. The flexible connecting frame can be bent and deformed; the two driving lower limb assemblies are connected with the trunk wearing assembly through a flexible connecting frame; the upper limb driving assembly and the lower limb driving assembly can be quickly connected and matched; the driving upper limb assembly can also be quickly connected and matched with an external execution tool; the posture detection assembly is used for detecting motion postures of the upper limb driving assembly and the lower limb driving assembly. According to the exoskeleton robot, the stooping operation comfort can be improved, various kinds of work assistance can be achieved, and the adaptability is better.
source_title: Compact mining whole-body power-assisted exoskeleton robot with anti-explosion shell and posture monitoring function

abstract: The invention discloses a quick human movement identification method oriented to human-computer interaction. The method comprises the following steps that: (1) collecting bone point coordinate information; (2) selecting a key point; (3) extracting movement characteristics; (4) carrying out movement identification; and (5) using a robot. The invention provides the quick human movement identification method oriented to the human-computer interaction. The whole system consists of a terminal computer, Kinect human movement input equipment, a Bluetooth communication module and a robot. Firstly, theKinect is used for capturing a human body, effective nodes which can represent whole-body movement are extracted from 20 joint nodes and are calculated to obtain movement characteristics, and a movement template is formed and stored into a TXT text. In an identification stage, a movement sequence to be tested and a standard template are quickly matched through an F-DTW (Fast Dynamic Time Warping)algorithm, and an identification result is given. According to a movement identification result, the robot makes different responses. By use of a quick algorithm, movement identification speed is greatly improved, and quickly control for the robot is optimized.
source_title: Quick human movement identification method oriented to human-computer interaction

abstract: The present invention relates to a massage module head of a massage robot. Based on human body shape information using human body scanning, massage for each part of a human body is automatically performed. Based on a user's body shape information obtained through user body scanning, automatic massage for each part of a body can be performed evenly while the massage module head moves in the X-axis, Y-axis, and X-axis. In addition, as the massage is performed based on the user's body scanning information, excessive or too weak massage is prevented from being performed on a specific part of the body. It is possible to ensure even pressure massage over the whole body.
source_title: MASSAGE MODULE HEAD OF MASSAGE ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses a monitoring camera and a control method of the monitoring camera. The present invention can count people passing through a counting line by determining whether or not at least one of a bounding box of a head region and a bounding box of a whole body region among bounding boxes of an object detected in a side view image intersects with the preset counting line. In the present invention, one or more of a monitoring camera, an autonomous vehicle, a user terminal, and a server can be linked to an artificial intelligence module, a robot, an augmented reality (AR) device, a virtual reality (VR) device, a device related to a 5G service, and the like.
source_title: Surveillance camera and control method of surveillance camera

abstract: A robot manipulator comprises a base (102 figure 1); an arm (1108, 112 figure 1) connected to the base (102 figure 1) via at least a shoulder joint (110 figure 1); and a control system comprising a force selector. The control system receives target trajectory instructions defining a target trajectory of a distal end of the arm; generates instructions defining target motion of the base based on the received target trajectory instructions and determines an effective force which, when applied to the base, could cause the base to execute the target motion according to the instructions. In response to one or more applied forces on the robot manipulator, the control system is further configured to determine one or more of: a virtual zero moment point (ZMP) force which, when applied to the base, would either counteract an observed motion of a ZMP of the robot manipulator, or act to move the ZMP back to within a predetermined support region; and an external force applied to the base. The force selector is configured to receive data defining the effective force and at least one of the virtual ZMP force and the external force applied to the base, and to determine a target force based on the data; and the control system is configured to generate instructions which, when executed by the base, cause the base to execute motion in response to the target force. Dynamic stability of the robot manipulator is maintained if unexpected external forces are experienced. The robot manipulator may be a 3D cleaning device. The control system may generate compliant behaviour of the robot manipulator.
source_title: Dynamic stability of a robot manipulator

abstract: The invention relates to a method and device for adjusting center of mass position of a robot, a robot and a data storage medium. The method includes the steps: obtaining an initial value of the poseof the waist, an initial value of the pose of the double feet and an initial value of the center of mass position, according to three mass block models and a center of mass position planning value; obtaining a waist velocity adjustment value by means of the linear positive correlation corresponding to the pose change of the waist and the positional change of the center of mass; according to the initial value of the pose of the waist, the waist velocity adjustment value and the initial value of the pose of the double feet, obtaining the current value of the center of mass position through calculation; comparing whether the current value of the center of mass position is equal to the center of mass position planning value; if so, obtaining the current value of the center of mass position asthe initial value of the next center of mass position, and returning to the step according to the initial value of the center of mass position and the center of mass position planning value until thecurrent value of the center of mass position is equal to the center of mass position planning value; and if not, generating a target control system command according to the current value of the centerof mass position. The method for adjusting center of mass position of a robot improves the balance ability of the robot.
source_title: Method and device for adjusting center of mass position of robot, robot and data storage medium

abstract: The invention provides a whole body movement planning method and system of a robot, and relates to the technical field of robot movement planning. The whole body movement planning method comprises thesteps of receiving a control instruction containing an operating target; establishing a movement plan according to the current gesture of the movable robot and the operating target; respectively calculating associated values between the movement plan and all intelligent processing models, and arranging the associated values in sequence from big to small so as to form an associated value queue; performing state feasibility inspection on the standard movement plan associated with the intelligent processing model which corresponds to the foremost associated value in the associated value queue soas to obtain a feasibility inspection result; and obtaining the whole body movement planning information of the movable robot according to the movement plan, the intelligent processing model and thefeasibility inspection result, wherein the movable robot performs the corresponding movement according to the whole body movement planning information so as to realize the operating target. Accordingto the whole body movement planning method, the whole body movement planning information obtained by study is stored as a new intelligent processing model, so that the whole body movement planning efficiency is effectively improved, and the applicability is high.
source_title: Whole body movement planning method and system of robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot control method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps that for the robot with a first mechanical leg set and a second mechanical leg set, an expected operation space task of the robot on a supporting face is obtained, and the expected operation space task is used for guiding the robot to alternately swing the first mechanical leg set and the second mechanical leg set so as to move on the supporting face; according to the expected operation space task and a whole-body kinetic model of the robot, an expected joint torque set corresponding to the expected operation space task is obtained, and the expected joint torque set comprises expected joint torques used for controlling all parts of the robot; and according to the expected joint torque set, the robot is controlled to move under the guidance of the expected operation space task. According to the embodiment of the invention, the control accuracy of the robot is improved through the whole-body dynamic model, and the moving efficiency of the robot is improved through the expected operation space task.
source_title: Robot control method, device and equipment and storage medium

abstract: The invention relates to a foot type robot and a motion control method of the foot type robot. The method comprises the following steps: responding to a reverse joint standing instruction, wherein the reverse joint standing instruction comprises switching from a positive joint standard standing state to a reverse joint standing state; determining a joint initial angle value of the positive joint in a standard standing state and a mechanical limiting angle value of the negative joint in a standing state; entering a positive joint standard standing state based on a whole body control algorithm; based on the joint initial angle value and the mechanical limiting angle value, determining a first discrete angle value for moving from a positive joint standard standing state to a negative joint standing state; and the first discrete angle value is converted into first joint torque based on joint proportional differential control, and a thigh motor and a shank motor are controlled to rotate based on the first joint torque, so that the foot type robot reaches reverse joint mechanical limiting in a reverse joint standing state. By adopting the method, stable switching of different states of the foot type robot can be improved.
source_title: Foot type robot and motion control method of foot type robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a system for controlling a robot for maintaining the entire posture of the robot which is not fixated on the ground. The robot comprises: a body which comprises multiple joints; multiple limbs; and a motor mounted on the joints. The position of the center of mass of the robot is controlled to keep the entire posture. The limbs comprise a robot arm having an end unit. When the end unit′s target position value is entered, the center of mass′s target position value is calculated by using the end unit′s target position value. The end unit′s target position value and the center of mass′s target position value are followed to drive the motor mounted on the joints for the center of mass of the end unit and the robot to move. The center of mass′s target position value changes in proportion to the changes of the end unit′s target position value.
source_title: SYSTEM FOR CONTROLLING POSITION POSE OF ROBOT USING CONTROL OF CENTER OF MASS

abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot balance control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps as follows: acquiring left and right foot stress information of the robot; calculating a zero moment point of a body centroid of the robot according to the left and right foot stress information; calculating a first position offset and a second position offset of the robot according to the zero moment point of the body centroid respectively; updating the position track of the robot according to the first position offset and the second position offset to obtain an updated body centroid position; performing inverse kinematics analysis on the updated body centroid position to obtain eachjoint angle of the left leg and the right leg of the robot; and controlling the robot to move according to each joint angle. Stability of the robot in the bending process is improved, and toppling isavoided.
source_title: Robot balance control method and device, readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a one-step prediction whole-body control method and device of a foot type robot and the foot type robotic.The method comprises the steps that motion of the foot type robot is decomposed into a plurality of subtasks related to motion according to the motion instruction requirement of the foot type robot, obtaining a reference parameter and a feedback parameter at the current moment in a task space in which each sub-task is located; according to the feedback state of the robot, each subtask related to motion is set as a one-step prediction task, all the subtasks are placed in an objective function of an optimization problem, proper constraint conditions are set in the optimization problem, and the optimization problem is solved according to feedback parameters so as to coordinate and complete all the subtasks. And generating a control instruction of the foot type robot according to the optimal solution of the optimization problem to realize whole-body control of the foot type robot. Therefore, the problems that a whole-body control method in the prior art lacks predictive control ability and has many control parameters are solved.
source_title: One-step prediction whole-body control method and device of foot type robot and foot type robot

abstract: A walking robot having a hydraulic motion control device and a method for controlling the same are provided to improve walking stability of the walking robot by allowing the walking robot to walk according to an orbit of a ZMP(Zero Moment Point). A walking robot having a hydraulic motion control device comprises a pair of foot members(11a,11b), a pair of leg members provided at upper portions of the foot members, thigh members provided at upper portions of the leg members, and pelvic members(50) provided at upper portions of the thigh members. Upper tanks(21a,21b) are installed at upper portions of the pelvic members, intermediate tanks(26a,26b) serving as the thigh members are installed at lower portions of the pelvic members, and lower tanks(27a,27b) serving as the leg members are installed at lower portions of the thigh members. A base frame(40) is located on the pelvic members and a hydraulic tank unit(21) is installed on the base frame. A hydraulic pump(60) is installed at one side of the hydraulic tank unit to supply fluid to the tanks.
source_title: ROBOT HAVING MOTION CONTROL DEVICE FOR IMPROVING WALKING STABILITY AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THE SAME

abstract: The invention provides a whole-body control method of a mobile composite robot. The whole-body control method comprises the following steps: S1, establishing an integrated system model in a world coordinate system; s2, analyzing an external data instruction into an input control quantity of the whole-body controller; s3, transmitting the state parameters to the integrated system model; transmitting the sensing data to a whole body controller; s4, transmitting a system theoretical adjustment vector parameter to a whole body controller; s5, generating a total control quantity; s6, inverse analytical calculation is executed, and the control quantity of the moving body and the operation control quantity of the mechanical arm are obtained; and S7, the control quantity is transmitted to a controller corresponding to the moving body and a controller corresponding to the mechanical arm. According to the method, how to calculate the control quantities of the moving body and the mechanical arm of the robot is not independently distinguished, the moving control quantity of the moving body and the control quantity of the mechanical arm are analyzed based on the total control quantity only after the total control quantity is finally obtained, and walking and operation actions of the robot have high synchronism and coordination.
source_title: Whole body control method of mobile composite robot

abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot control, in particular to a robot control method and device and a storage medium. The robot control method comprises the steps that a robot supporting leg knee joint angle and a swinging leg knee joint angle are obtained; determining a support leg knee joint angle and a swing leg knee joint angle; determining a target discrete support leg knee joint angle and a target discrete swing leg knee joint angle based on the support leg knee joint angle interval and the swing leg knee joint angle interval; based on the target kinetic parameters corresponding to the target discrete support leg knee joint angle and the target discrete swing leg knee joint angle, generating a joint torque control instruction for performing whole-body control on the robot; and performing whole-body control on the robot based on the joint torque control instruction. According to the invention, the dependence on the computing power of control hardware is reduced, and the response speed and the control precision of the joint are improved.
source_title: Robot control method and device and storage medium

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and particularly relates to a gait switching control method and system for a foot type mechanical arm robot, and the method comprises the following steps: calculating the current gait of the foot type mechanical arm robot and the position of a zero moment point of the gait to be switched; a zero moment point reference track of the foot type mechanical arm robot is planned; and controlling the foot type mechanical arm robot to move according to the zero moment point reference track by using a model predictive control algorithm, adjusting control parameters of the predictive control algorithm in real time according to a loss function, and outputting a state track and an input track in real time so as to realize gait switching of the foot type mechanical arm robot. According to the gait switching control method of the foot type mechanical arm robot, the influence of mechanical arm dynamics on the movement performance of the whole robot is fully considered, and gait switching control of the foot type robot can be achieved.
source_title: Gait switching control method and system of foot type mechanical arm robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a massage robot. Based on human body shape information using human body scanning, massage for each part of a human body is automatically performed. Based on a user's body shape information obtained through user body scanning, automatic massage for each part of a body can be performed evenly while the massage module head moves in the X-axis, Y-axis, and X-axis. In addition, as the massage is performed based on the user's body scanning information, excessive or too weak massage is prevented from being performed on a specific part of the body. It is possible to ensure even pressure massage over the whole body.
source_title: MASSAGE ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a voice output method based on robot recognition. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a whole-body image of an interaction object; detecting a human face area and a body area in the whole-body image; extracting human face features in the human face area; extracting body features in the body area; connecting the human face features and the body features to obtain feature vectors; inputting the feature vectors into a pretrained group type-voice feature model, thus obtaining group type of the interaction object and target voice features corresponding to thegroup type; and outputting preset voice according to the target voice features. The invention further provides a voice output device based on robot recognition, a robot and a medium. According to theinvention, the group type-voice feature model can be obtained through training, voice can be output with pertinence according to the group type of the interaction object, and then the intelligence degree of the robot is improved.
source_title: Voice output method and device based on robot recognition, robot and medium

abstract: The invention discloses a whole body exoskeleton power-assisted robot for auxiliary carrying and relates to the field of power-assisted robot research. The whole body exoskeleton power-assisted robot comprises a back bracket, a central controller, power devices, upper limb components and lower limb components. The central controller is fixedly connected to the back side of the back bracket. The two upper limb components which are the same in structure are installed on the two sides of the back bracket correspondingly. The power devices are installed on first shoulder joints, second shoulder joints and elbow joints of the exoskeleton power-assisted robot and provide assistance for movement of exoskeletons. The exoskeleton lower limb components are installed under the two sides of the back bracket. When a person wears the exoskeleton power-assisted robot to carry a heavy object, the gravity of the heavy object is transmitted to the ground through the exoskeleton lower limb components. Each power device is composed of a transmission device, a harmonic reducer, a disc type motor and an angle sensor. The angle sensors are used for measuring the angle value of the joints, and the central controller controls the corresponding joints to move according to the measured angle value.
source_title: Whole body exoskeleton power-assisted robot for auxiliary carrying

abstract: The invention provides a robot control method and device, electronic equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, and is applied to the technical field of robotics.The method comprises the steps that the current state parameter of a to-be-controlled robot at the current moment is obtained; calling a state regulator, and determining basic control parameters for each joint of the to-be-controlled robot based on a preset dynamic model and the current state parameters; performing parameter filtering processing on the basic control parameters to obtain safety control parameters for each joint of the to-be-controlled robot; calling a whole-body dynamic model of the to-be-controlled robot, and determining a motion control parameter of each joint of the to-be-controlled robot based on the safety control parameter of each joint; and based on the motion control parameter of each joint, controlling the corresponding joint of the to-be-controlled robot at the current moment. According to the invention, the safety control of the robot can be realized, and the robustness of robot control is improved.
source_title: Robot control method and device, electronic equipment, computer readable storage medium and computer program product

abstract: The invention relates to a mobile robot which is able to follow a trajectory and adopt a behavior which can be defined by movements of articulated limbs of the robot. The mobile robot is equipped with a processor which is configured, based on instructions defining a motion of the mobile robot and instructions defining a behavior of the mobile robot, to calculate a target trajectory of a center of mass of the mobile robot; calculate, based on the target trajectory of the center of mass of the mobile robot and dynamic constraints of the mobile robot, a predicted trajectory (350)of the center of mass of the mobile robot over a time horizon, and calculate, based on the predicted trajectory of the center of mass of the mobile robot and the instructions defining a behavior of the mobile robot, predicted movements of articulated limbs.
source_title: A MOBILE ROBOT WITH ENHANCED BALANCED MOTION AND BEHAVIOR CAPABILITIES

abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for determining an external force applied to a robotic arm. The robotic arm (10) includes a plurality of links (11), a plurality of joints (12) and a plurality of 6-DOF force and torque sensors (14). In the method, inertial property parameters and motion state parameters of each link are determined (S1, S2). An inertial force and an inertial torque at the center of mass of a target link are determined (S3). Forces and torques between the two ends of the target link and the corresponding joints are acquired respectively by the 6-DOF force and torque sensors (S4). The external force applied to the target link is determined according to the inertial force and the inertial torque at the center of mass of the target link, and the forces and the torques between the two ends of the target link and the corresponding joints (S5).
source_title: METHOD FOR DETERMINING EXTERNAL FORCE APPLIED TO ROBOTIC ARM, ROBOTIC ARM AND STORAGE MEDIUM

abstract: The whole-body exoskeleton robot for heavy object carrying comprises a waist back plate mechanism, shoulder mechanisms are symmetrically hinged to the two sides, close to the upper end, of the waist back plate mechanism, hip mechanisms are symmetrically connected to the two sides, close to the lower end, of the waist back plate mechanism, and the lower ends of the hip mechanisms are sequentially connected with leg mechanisms; a power device is arranged at the end, far away from the waist and back plate mechanism, of the shoulder mechanism, the power device is connected with the arm mechanism, and the arm mechanism can rotate along the shoulder mechanism; knee pressure spring telescopic rods are hinged to the leg mechanisms, and the knee pressure spring telescopic rods are located at knee joints; the waist and back plate mechanism comprises a back plate, the back plate is hinged to the shoulder mechanism, the lower end of the back plate is connected with a first waist plate, the lower end of the first waist plate is hinged to a second waist plate, and a waist compression spring telescopic rod is further hinged between the second waist plate and the first waist plate; and the second waist plate is connected with the hip mechanism. The mode that active assistance and passive assistance are combined is adopted, the assistance effect is obvious, and wearing is more flexible.
source_title: Whole-body exoskeleton robot for heavy object carrying

abstract: The invention discloses a hybrid-driven whole-body exoskeleton robot which comprises lower limb assistance systems, upper limb cooperation assistance systems and a back structure, the lower limb assistance systems, the upper limb cooperation assistance systems and the back structure are all of a bilateral symmetry structure, and the two upper limb cooperation assistance systems are installed on the two sides of the upper end of the back structure correspondingly. The two lower limb assistance systems are installed on the two sides of the lower end of the back structure correspondingly, the upper limb cooperation assistance system comprises a three-degree-of-freedom spherical parallel joint and a tail end executing mechanism, and the tail end executing mechanism is fixedly installed at the tail end of the three-degree-of-freedom spherical parallel joint and controlled and driven by the three-degree-of-freedom spherical parallel joint. The lower limb assisting system comprises knee joints, hip joints and ankle joints, the upper ends of the knee joints are hinged to the hip joints, the lower ends of the knee joints are hinged to the ankle joints, and the ankle joints are fixedly connected with the foot wearing device. The robot has the heavy load power assisting capacity and the cooperative operation capacity at the same time, and the upper limbs, the hip joints and the knee joints select different driving modes to achieve efficient driving.
source_title: Hybrid-driven whole-body exoskeleton robot

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and device for controlling a foot type robot, the foot type robot, equipment for controlling the foot type robot and a non-volatile computer readable storage medium. The foot type robot comprises a base and at least two mechanical legs, each mechanical leg comprises at least one joint, and the method comprises the steps that in response to the fact that all the mechanical legs of the foot type robot fall to make contact with a plane, a first expected track and a second expected track corresponding to the foot type robot are determined, the first expected trajectory indicates an expected trajectory of movement of the center of mass of the legged robot in a gravity direction and an expected trajectory of change of an inclination angle of the legged robot; the second expected track indicates an expected track of one end, far away from the base, of each mechanical leg; and on the basis of a kinetic model corresponding to the foot type robot, the first expected track and the second expected track, controlling the action of each joint after the foot type robot is in contact with the plane.
source_title: Method and device for controlling foot type robot and foot type robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a robot motion generation system to control the motion of an output robot to enable a walking robot to follow the motion of an input robot or a human being (″input robot″) which includes a measurement module extracting information on a center of mass (CoM) position (″input CoM information″) and information on a zero moment point (ZMP) position (″input ZMP information″) of the input robot; and a conversion module generating information on CoM position (″output CoM information″) and information on ZMP position (″output ZMP information″) of the output robot to control the balance of the output robot using the CoM input information and the ZMP input information, wherein the conversion module uses a maximum step ratio of the output robot with respect to the maximum step of the input robot and an initial CoM height ratio of the output robot with respect to an initial CoM height of the input robot as parameters to approximate the input CoM information and the input ZMP information in order to generate the output CoM information and the output ZMP information in real time.
source_title: Real time robot motion generating system applied to different robot structure

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control systems, in particular to a robot whole-body motion control method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: collecting inertial measurement unit data and motor feedback data in real time through a reasoning node; inputting the inertial measurement unit data and the motor feedback data into a deep reinforcement learning model accelerated by TensorRT, and generating a control instruction of the motor; the control instruction is issued through a master station node by using an Ethernet control automation technology bus, and the upper layer of the master station node runs a four-state state machine including an initialization state, an enabling state, a motor control state and a fault state; according to the invention, high-frequency real-time control, multi-scene self-adaptive adjustment and multi-level safety protection of whole-body motion of the robot are realized, and the problems of poor generalization, low real-time response speed and single safety protection mechanism in traditional robot control are solved.
source_title: Robot whole-body motion control method and system based on reinforcement learning

abstract: The invention discloses a robot teleoperation control method and device, a robot and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target action data and displacement data of a target object, wherein the target action data comprises head action data and arm action data; the target robot is controlled to act according to the target action data, so that the target robot completes the action corresponding to the target action data; and according to the displacement data, based on an MPC algorithm, carrying out mass center trajectory planning on the target robot to obtain a target mass center trajectory, and establishing a spring-damping system to track the target mass center trajectory so as to enable the target robot to move to a position corresponding to the displacement data. The technical problem that whole-body teleoperation of the robot cannot be achieved in the prior art is solved.
source_title: Robot teleoperation control method and device, robot and electronic equipment

abstract: The invention relates to a robotic vehicle (100) for movable operation in a work area (108), the movable operation comprising a soil cultivation, the vehicle (100) comprising a controller comprising a memory (122) and instructions (124), two simultaneously driven drive wheels (1500), a mass component (600) essential for a center of mass (S) of the vehicle (100), an actuator (608) and a sensor module (604) in communicative connection with the controller, the wheels (1500) being spaced apart from each other in the transverse direction of the vehicle (100), the mass component (600) being displaceable by the actuator (608) in the transverse direction along a straight line, the sensor module (604) being adapted for determining in the transverse direction the position of the center of mass (S) of the vehicle (100) and signaling the position to the controller, wherein execution of the instructions (124) by the processor (120) causes the controller to control the actuator (608) for a movement of the mass component (600) along the straight line depending on the signaled position of the center of mass (S).
source_title: ROBOTIC VEHICLE FOR MOVABLE OPERATION IN A WORK AREA

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot switching robot system and a control method thereof, a robot comprises a robot trunk, a mechanical leg mechanism mounted at the bottom of the robot trunk and a wheel type mechanism mounted at the upper part of the robot, and the wheel type mechanism and the mechanical leg mechanism are independent of each other; the mechanical leg mechanisms achieve switching of the motion postures of the robot through contraction or extension. The control method of the robot system comprises the following steps of switching real-time postures of a robot before switching; planning a gravity center motion track of the robot trunk part; judging whether each zero moment point in the planned gravity center motion trail of the robot trunk part meets a balance condition within a stability threshold of the robot or not; and if the balance condition is met, contracting or stretching the mechanical leg mechanisms according to the rotating angles of all joints of the robot toachieve stable switching, the problem that the robot loses balance due to the fact that the gravity center of the robot changes during trade wheel-foot switching is avoided, and stable wheel-foot switching can be conducted on complex terrains.
source_title: Wheel-foot switching robot system and control method thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a nursing robot for old people. A head part, a body part and an omnidirectional wheel bottom plate are arranged, the nursing robot for the old people further comprises a controller for receiving robot state information and operation information and sending a control instruction to the robot, a multifunctional input system comprising a microphone used for inputting specificcontrol information, a health condition monitoring system and a home monitoring system comprising a temperature and humidity sensor and a smoke sensor and used for monitoring home temperature and humidity and smoke concentration environment information respectively, reminding the old people to adjust the temperature and the humidity in time and detecting home fire hazards, and an alarm system comprising a loudspeaker and an alarm lamp. The nursing robot for the old people provided by the invention not only can monitor and nurse the physical condition of the elder, but also can monitor the surrounding environment, regulate and control the air temperature and humidity, and can give an alarm when smoke is detected, and meanwhile, a traditional complex structure is avoided, the size is small,the weight is light, the whole body is simpler, and the light-weight load requirement is met.
source_title: Nursing robot for old people

abstract: The invention provides a robot. An independent and active suspension device cooperated with an undercarriage device is designed in the robot to ensure the stability of a body and obtain the most flexible exercise performance, the robot not only can travel like general vehicles, but also can spin in place and walk all around, and when the robot turns around while walking, the robot also has the smallest turning radius and does not occupy space, the robot has the advantages of excellent abilities to climb slopes, climb stairs and climb obstacles and can cross the 45-degree steep slope. In addition, according to the robot system, the body height can be changed adaptively at any time, by adopting the telescopic neck of the robot, the location of the center of mass can be changed, the view of the neck can also be increased by adjusting, and the angle stability of the neck of the robot in three axial directions is ensured and the vibration of the body caused by the rough of the ground in motion is relieved, and the body of the robot on the move is stable and will not dump.
source_title: Robot system

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a robot control method, a robot and a computer readable storage medium. According to the robot control method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the base control information for keeping the balance of the ball body is determined by adding passive control on a nonlinear system consisting of the base part of the wheel-legged robot and the ball body on the base part in whole-body control on the wheel-legged robot; the control of each joint of the robot is determined based on the base control information, so that the wheel-legged robot can keep the balance of a ball on the wheel-legged robot in the moving process, and the ball balancing task of the wheel-legged robot is achieved. Through the robot control method disclosed by the invention, the wheel-legged robot can realize the balance of balls with different rigidities on road surfaces of various terrains, and after different balls are replaced, the stability of a balance ball system can be ensured only by updating corresponding parameters of the balls into the controller, and the controller does not need to be debugged again.
source_title: Robot control method and robot

abstract: The invention provides a multi-legged rescue robot motion control method and device based on supporting leg distribution optimization. The multi-legged rescue robot motion control method based on supporting leg distribution optimization comprises the steps that a mass center coordinate point of a multi-legged rescue robot is obtained; under the condition that the motion acceleration of the hydraulic device of the multi-legged rescue robot is smaller than an acceleration threshold value, the mass center coordinate point is determined as a zero moment point of the multi-legged rescue robot; and determining the safety margin of the multi-legged rescue robot based on the vertical distance between the zero moment point and the supporting area associated with the multiple supporting legs, and obtaining the adjustment increment of the multi-legged rescue robot under the condition that the safety margin is controlled to be kept maximum by adjusting the postures of the mechanical arm and the target supporting leg. According to the method, the posture of the robot can be adaptively adjusted according to the terrain, and the automation degree and safety of the multi-legged rescue robot under the complex terrain are improved.
source_title: Multi-legged rescue robot motion control method and device based on supporting leg distribution optimization

abstract: A robotic device includes a control system. The control system receives a first measurement indicative of a first distance between a center of mass of the machine and a first position in which a first leg of the machine last made initial contact with a surface. The control system also receives a second measurement indicative of a second distance between the center of mass of the machine and a second position in which the first leg of the machine was last raised from the surface. The control system further determines a third position in which to place a second leg of the machine based on the received first measurement and the received second measurement. Additionally, the control system provides instructions to move the second leg of the machine to the determined third position.
source_title: Generalized coordinate surrogates for integrated estimation and control

abstract: The present disclosure discloses a method and apparatus for controlling robot motion, a device and a storage medium, which belongs to the field of robot motion control technologies. The method includes: determining a remaining duration of a current stepping cycle, wherein the remaining duration is a duration from a current moment to an end moment of the current stepping cycle; predicting, based on the remaining duration, an expected velocity of a robot, a first center of mass position and a first instantaneous velocity of the robot at the current moment, and a state space equation, a second center of mass position and a second instantaneous velocity of the robot at the end moment of the current stepping cycle; determining, based on the expected velocity, the second center of mass position and the second instantaneous velocity, a stable foothold position corresponding to the current stepping cycle; determining, based on the stable foothold position and the second center of mass position, a motion parameter corresponding to each joint in the robot associated with stepping; and controlling the robot based on the motion parameter corresponding to each joint. By means of the solution, it is beneficial to improve the stability of the robot during the motion.
source_title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR CONTROLLING ROBOT MOTION, DEVICE AND STORAGE MEDIUM

abstract: The invention relates to a torque control foot type robot with a rotatable waist and a control method of the torque control foot type robot. The control method comprises the following steps that an initial gait data set of the foot type robot is obtained; a simulation learning framework based on an asymmetric act-critic structure is constructed; performing iterative training on a strategy based on the simulation reward and the task reward by utilizing the simulation learning framework to obtain a gait data set after waist self-adaptive training; based on the gait data set after waist self-adaptive training, motor parameters and environment parameters of the foot type robot are trained through course learning, and a final gait data set is obtained; based on the final gait data set, the waist of the foot type robot is made to rotate by controlling the output torque of a waist motor, and whole-body control over the foot type robot is achieved. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of low control complexity, high steering capability, good scene adaptability and the like.
source_title: Torque control foot type robot with rotatable waist and control method thereof

abstract: A legged robot subjected to a force is controlled by determining an instantaneous capture point where the robot will step with a swing leg to reach a balanced home position, the balanced home position being a state in which the Center of Mass remains substantially over the Center of Pressure and the robot is able to maintain its balance indefinitely. The capture point can be determined using a Linear Inverted Pendulum Plus Flywheel (LIPPF) model of the robot. The LIPPF model includes a flywheel with a mass and a rotational inertia, and a variable length leg link. A torque profile is applied to the flywheel and a set of capture points is determined based on this torque profile An experimentally determined error value can be added to a capture point that is determined based on the model to account for differences between an actual robot and the model.
source_title: Determination of foot placement for humanoid push recovery

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of exoskeleton robots, in particular to a multi-limb exoskeleton walking balance control method, device and equipment and a storage medium. The zero moment point coordinate of the wearer can be accurately calculated by acquiring the sensing information, the stable supporting polygonal area is determined, when the zero moment point is not in the stable supporting polygonal area, the balance auxiliary mode can be executed according to the phase state of the robot, the safety of the wearer is ensured, and the safety of the wearer is improved. According to the method, the phase state of the robot is obtained according to the walking state and the environment of the wearer in the sensing information, the balance state of the wearer is accurately judged, the robot can quickly make a balance strategy according to the gravity center change of the wearer, the calculation process is simple, the requirement for software and hardware of a control system is low, cost and technical difficulty are reduced, and the method is suitable for popularization and application. No matter in daily life or in a special working environment, reliable balance assistance can be provided for a wearer, and the safety and stability of actions are improved.
source_title: Multi-limb exoskeleton walking balance control method, device and equipment and storage medium

abstract: A robot design system, and associated method, that is particularly well-suited for legged robots (e.g., monopods, bipeds, and quadrupeds). The system implements three stages or modules: (a) a motion optimization module; (b) a morphology optimization module; and (c) a link length optimization module. The motion optimization module outputs motion trajectories of the robot's center of mass (COM) and force effectors. The morphology optimization module uses as input the optimized motion trajectories and a library of modular robot components and outputs an optimized robot morphology, e.g., a parameterized mechanical design in which the number of links in each of the legs and other parameters are optimized. The link length optimization module takes this as input and outputs optimal link lengths for a particular task such that the design of a robot is more efficient. The system solves the problem of automatically designing legged robots for given locomotion tasks by numerical optimization.
source_title: Computational design of robots from high-level task specifications

abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical arm trajectory planning method based on visual and dynamic motion primitives, and relates to the technical field of mechanical arm trajectory planning. Which comprises a robot and a computer, and comprises the following steps: human body back skin area segmentation: performing visual perception on the environment by using a visual system, and segmenting the human body skin area through a deep learning algorithm; a human body back skin area input trajectory planning system; learning a teaching track based on a dynamic motion primitive algorithm, and solving a weight parameter of the teaching track by using local weighted regression; a wiping motion track is generated, and the wiping motion track of the robot in the target area is generated in combination with human body back skin area environment information provided by a visual system; the robot executes the track to wipe the back skin of the human body, the robot executes the multi-contact operation task of wiping the back skin of the human body according to the motion track, the target area is segmented in real time, the execution precision of the robot in the task is improved, multi-modal information is fused, and the robot adapts to individual differences.
source_title: Mechanical arm trajectory planning method based on visual and dynamic motion primitives

abstract: The invention provides a quadruped robot whole-body coordination control method based on constraint and motion decoupling, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the quadruped robot whole-body coordination control method comprises the steps: 1, building a dynamic model; 2, multiplying the kinetic model by a null-space mapping matrix of the constraint matrix to obtain a motion space equation; 3, obtaining a control rate enabling the system to show impedance characteristics; 4, the control rate in the Cartesian space is converted into joint driving torque through Jacobian mapping; 5, a quadratic programming problem is constructed in the constraint space; 6, joint driving torque in the constraint space is obtained, and the sum of the joint driving torque and the joint torque obtained in the motion space is used as an instruction sent to each driving joint motor. Trajectory tracking control and compliance control are achieved, so that accurate motion control is kept in the walking process, certain compliance is achieved, the robot adapts to the uneven ground, whole-body coordination control is achieved, and the robot walks stably without slipping.
source_title: Quadruped robot whole-body coordination control method based on constraint and motion decoupling

abstract: The invention relates a cyclic detecting robot for the inner wall of a self-elevating offshore platform cylindrical pile leg. The whole body of the robot is composed of an extendable torso mechanism and an extensible leg and foot mechanism. Reciprocating crawling and obstacle avoidance of the robot are achieved through coordination of extending-retracting movement of a four-leg mechanism and the torso mechanism, and the robot has a certain degree of adaptability to wall faces with a certain radian degree. The robot can take the place of labor to conduct cyclic detecting to the inner wall of the self-elevating offshore platform cylindrical pile leg by carrying related equipment and systems, such as vision and crack detection.
source_title: Cyclic detecting robot for inner wall of self-elevating offshore platform cylindrical pile leg

abstract: The invention discloses a one-legged robot mechanism for wall jumping and a control method. The one-legged robot mechanism comprises a robot leg part, wherein a body of the robot leg part is fixedly connected with a plurality of rotors; the plurality of rotors are distributed in a mirror-image manner relative to the body; and working surfaces of the plurality of rotors are parallel to each other.The one-legged robot mechanism is additionally provided with rotor mechanisms so as to actively control the trajectory of the center of mass and body posture of a robot in the air. In combination withthe control method disclosed by the invention, the one-legged robot mechanism can realize the technical effect of continuous jumping on vertical walls and improve the application situation and motionability of the robot.
source_title: One-legged robot mechanism for wall jumping and control method

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-contact mechanical clamping jaw on a sorting machine. The mechanical clamping jaw comprises a manipulator, wherein the manipulator is composed of a C-shaped connecting seat, clamping rods, driving rods, auxiliary rods and gears, vertical positioning sleeves are formed at the tail ends of the clamping rods, D-shaped central holes are formed in the positioning sleeves, D-shaped studs are inserted into the central holes of the positioning sleeves, the upper ends of the D-shaped studs are sleeved with fixed clamping jaws in an inserted mode, and the lower ends of the D-shaped studs are sleeved with elastic clamping jaws in an inserted mode. The adopted mechanical clamping jaw is provided with a plurality of clamping points making contact with the logistics pieces, the clamping effect is good, the mechanical clamping jaw is suitable for clamping the logistics pieces of various shapes and structures, and sorting operation of the robot is facilitated.
source_title: Multi-contact mechanical clamping jaw on sorting machine

abstract: The invention relates to a method for movement of a load from an initial point to a final point by a robotic arm comprising a plurality of segments and, at the terminal end of the plurality of segments, at least one end effector capable of meeting the load, the method comprising: determining a trajectory of the centre of mass of the load between the initial point at an initial time and zero speed and the final point at a final time and zero speed, passing through at least one local extremum of altitude at which the vertical speed of the centre of mass of the load is zero, said determination of the trajectory comprising: determining a vertical acceleration time profile comprising, in each interval between the initial point, the final point and a local extremum of altitude, an uninterrupted succession of a vertical acceleration phase and a vertical deceleration phase; and determining a horizontal acceleration time profile comprising an uninterrupted succession of at least one horizontal acceleration phase and at least one horizontal deceleration phase between a fourth time greater than or equal to the initial time and a sixth time less than or equal to the final time; sending control instructions to at least one effector of the robotic arm in order to apply the trajectory profile of the centre of mass of the load.
source_title: OPTIMISED TRAJECTORIES FOR ROBOTIC ARMS

abstract: The disclosure provides a motion control method and apparatus of a robot, a robot and a storage medium, wherein the robot is a wheel-foot composite robot, the wheel-foot composite robot comprises a robot body and four motion mechanisms arranged on the robot body, the four motion mechanisms comprise two rear rollers and two front leg mechanisms, and the method comprises: obtaining a to-be-performed task of the wheel-foot composite robot; determining a first motion task of a robot body, a second motion task of the two front leg mechanisms and a third motion task of the two rear rollers based on the to-be-performed task; and controlling the whole-body motion of the wheel-foot composite robot based on the first motion task, the second motion task and the third motion task.
source_title: MOTION CONTROL METHOD AND APPARATUS OF ROBOT, ROBOT AND STORAGE MEDIUM

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot joint control, and discloses a robot dog mechanical joint control method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a whole-body joint real-time sensing data set which covers the torque reading of a multi-axial force sensor, the angle data of a joint encoder and the body attitude data of an inertial measurement unit; motion state compensation is carried out on the sensing data based on a dynamic window mechanism, and a dynamic compensation matrix containing kinematics compensation parameters is generated; and inputting the multi-modal motion control data set into a gradient descent model under space-time constraint to complete multi-modal motion feature fusion so as to obtain a fusion motion control data set. Joint behavior abnormity is detected through a Lyapunov stability analysis algorithm, and abnormal nodes are identified; and iteratively optimizing control parameters through a fuzzy PID optimization algorithm to generate an optimized control parameter set, finally constructing a three-dimensional virtual motion space model, and establishing a dynamic mapping relationship between a virtual track and an actual mechanism.
source_title: Robot dog mechanical joint control method

abstract: A method of payload estimation and a robot arm system and an electronic device using the same are disclosed for acquiring inertial parameters of a payload. The method comprises calculating a payload mass, merely rotating a forth joint of the robot arm system to calculate an equivalent moment of inertia of the payload, merely rotating a second joint to measure data for dynamic equations of a fourth joint, repeating at least two times to obtain at least two sets of the dynamic parameters to calculate a center of mass of the payload, and substituting the payload mass, the equivalent moment of inertia and the center of mass into an equation of parallel axis theorem to obtain a moment of inertia of the payload. The center of mass is calculated by solving two dynamic equations associated with the fourth joint, thus the computation complexity of the payload inertial parameters is reduced.
source_title: METHOD OF PAYLOAD ESTIMATION AND ROBOT ARM SYSTEM AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE USING THE SAME

abstract: The present invention discloses a six-degrees-of-freedom manipulator suitable for a service robot. The six-degrees-of-freedom manipulator comprises a shoulder joint module, a big arm structure part, an elbow joint module, a small arm structure part and a wrist joint module which are connected in series in order and are taken as a whole body to connect with the robot body. The six-degrees-of-freedom manipulator is provided with six rotation freedom degree, namely six shafts, wherein a shoulder joint pitching freedom degree is a first shaft, a shoulder joint deflection freedom degree is a secondshaft, an elbow joint rolling and rotation freedom degree is a third shaft, an elbow joint pitching freedom degree is a fourth shaft, an elbow joint rolling and rotation freedom degree is a fifth shaft, an elbow joint pitching freedom degree is a sixth shaft, and the shafts are linked to complete various motions. The six-degrees-of-freedom manipulator suitable for the service robot employs the human-simulated joint configuration layout, and is compact in structure connection, good in operability and high in motion precision.
source_title: Six-degrees-of-freedom manipulator suitable for service robot and service robot

abstract: The invention relates to a control method based on a leg-arm multiplexing hexapod robot and the robot, and the method comprises the following steps: building a model by taking the trunk mass center of the leg-arm multiplexing hexapod robot as an original point, and obtaining the feedforward force of each supporting leg of the robot by using the position vector of the leg supporting point of the robot relative to the mass center point and the virtual supporting force at the trunk mass center; constructing a whole-body dynamic model of the robot by utilizing the floating degree of freedom of the robot trunk, the motion degree of freedom of the robot joints and the obtained feedforward force of each supporting leg, and obtaining the joint torque of each supporting leg of the robot; acquiring a joint angle and a joint torque in a swing track of a non-supporting leg of the robot by utilizing the change of position coordinates of the robot; and achieving robot control based on the joint torque of each supporting leg and the joint angle and the joint torque of the non-supporting leg. Supporting force can be optimized in real time, the movement track can be adjusted, and robust movement under external force disturbance is achieved; and during arm type operation, a single-arm mode and a double-arm mode are flexibly configured, and various operations such as pushing and the like are realized.
source_title: Control method based on leg and arm multiplexing hexapod robot and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a multidirectional moving mechanism for a welcome robot, belongs to the technical field of welcome robots, and solves problems that an existing welcome robot can only move forward and backward when moving, if the welcome robot needs to moved at multiple angles, the whole body of the welcome robot can only be rotated, so that wheels at the bottom rub hard on the ground and then move, which is very inconvenient, and it is very easy to fall down when encountering obstacles. A large rotary disc is arranged in a movable base and fixedly connected with the movable base through a large rotary disc base; a stepping motor I is fixedly installed in the large rotary disc base, and an output end of the stepping motor I is rotatably connected with the large rotary disc; a steering wheel base is arranged below the large rotary disc; a steering wheel is rotatably arranged in the steering wheel base; two small rotary discs are arranged on the lower surface of the large rotary disc; a first groove is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the movable base; and a stepping motor II is fixedly mounted in the first groove.
source_title: Multidirectional moving mechanism for welcome robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a working unit of a wearable robot for transporting and installing a heavy material, which can adjust the location of a heavy material, which is an object of high-load work, by vertically transporting and rotating the heavy material for transportation and installation of the heavy material. The working unit of the wearable robot for transporting and installing a heavy material according to the present invention, which is composed of one among a lower-limb wearable unit, an upper-limb wearable unit, and a whole-body wearable unit, includes a frame having a steel body of which the lower part is mounted on the wearable robot and the upper part is bent to be positioned on the front side of a worker and a driving unit which is mounted on the frame to vertically move a wire (133) by winding or unwinding the wire which is supported by the frame and moved upward and downward in the front side of the worker. The working unit provides an effect which enables a worker wearing the wearable robot to perform tasks of mounting and fixing a heavy material on a wall or a column at a specific height alone by vertically transporting the heavy material as well as lifting and transporting the heavy material.
source_title: WORKING UNIT OF WEARABLE ROBOT FOR HANDLING HEAVY MATERIAL

abstract: The invention provides a high-flexibility multi-axis robot and double-joint modules thereof, and the high-flexibility multi-axis robot comprises three groups of double-joint modules, and further comprises a model building module which is used for building a robot motion model of the multi-axis robot according to the position distribution and the structure distribution of each group of double-joint modules in the multi-axis robot in combination with kinematics and dynamics models; the angle determination module is used for determining a first rotation angle range of the robot motion model according to the work task, and determining a second rotation angle sequence meeting the requirement according to the zero moment point in the first rotation angle range; the instruction determination module is used for obtaining a target control instruction according to the second rotation angle sequence; the working module is used for guiding the multi-axis robot to perform a working task according to the target control instruction; and the flexibility and the stability of the multi-axis robot in working tasks are ensured.
source_title: High-flexibility multi-axis robot and double-joint module thereof

abstract: Embodiments of the invention provide an approach for reproducing a human action with a robot. The approach includes receiving data representing motions and contact forces of the human as the human performs the action. The approach further includes approximating, based on the motions and contact forces data, the center of mass (CoM) trajectory of the human in performing the action. Finally, the approach includes generating a planned robot action for emulating the designated action by solving an inverse kinematics problem having the approximated human CoM trajectory as a hard constraint and the motion capture data as a soft constraint.
source_title: Robot action based on human demonstration

abstract: A system and method for generating commands for robot locomotion planning or robot locomotion itself The input to the system is images and videos of actual human locomotion The output of the system is a series of commands—preferably comprising vectors with joint angles, center of mass location information, footpoints, and velocities.
source_title: METHOD, APPARATUS, AND SYSTEM FOR HUMANOID LOCATION LEARNING FROM DEMONSTRATION

abstract: The invention relates to a design of a loading platform of a pneumatic pole climbing robot. A whole body is composed of two groups of pole climbing mechanisms which are crossed; each group of mechanism comprises a pair of vertical retractable air cylinders, a pair of retractable cylinder protection bodies, a pair of horizontal clamping air cylinders and a pair of clamping air cylinder protection frames; the two groups of mechanisms are mounted on a general supporting plate in a manner of staggering up and down and are crossed to do stretching and retracting motions, so that clamping and climbing of a guide rod are realized; a designed structure is compact and the robot can climb for a distance which is twice as long as a route by one-time motions; the efficiency is high, the balance is good and a designed space is large; and other high-altitude washing or detection equipment can be mounted, so that the effect of the loading platform is realized.
source_title: Design of loading platform of pneumatic pole climbing robot

abstract: The invention discloses a workshop transfer robot which comprises a main box body, a machine head and a machine tail. The machine head is arranged at one end of the main box body, the machine tail isarranged at the other end of the main box body, an infrared sensor is electrically connected with a sensing module, whether obstacles exist nearby a whole body or not can be sensed through the infrared sensor, and if the obstacles appear around, the infrared sensor sends out a signal, the sensing module receives the signal and transmits the signal to a microcontroller, the microcontroller transmits the signal to a control panel, and then the obstacles are avoided by adjusting a driving wheel, so that the collision risk is reduced, and the collision damage rate is greatly reduced; and a partition plate is arranged on one side of a storage battery, an electric push rod is fixedly installed on one side of the partition plate, one end of the electric push rod is connected with an anti-collision pad, the electric push rod is electrically connected with the infrared sensor, when the electric push rod is about to collide with the obstacles, the infrared sensor sends out the signal, meanwhile,the electric push rod is turned on, and the anti-collision pad plays a good role in buffering.
source_title: Workshop transfer robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. According to the method, foot-endstress information of the robot is obtained; a zero moment point of the mass center of a body of the robot is worked out according to the foot-end stress information; the position trajectory of the robot is updated according to the zero moment point of the mass center of the body, and then an updated position of the mass center of the body is obtained; pose information of the robot is obtained; the pose trajectory of the robot is updated according to the pose information, and then an updated pose angle is obtained; inverse kinematic analysis is performed on the updated position of the mass center of the body and the updated pose angle, and all joint angles of legs of the robot are obtained; and the robot is controlled to move according to all the joint angles, and the stability of the robot during travelling is greatly improved.
source_title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: A computing system and method for estimating friction and/or center of mass (CoM) are presented. The system may perform the method by selecting at least one of: (i) a first joint from among a plurality of joints, or (ii) a first arm segment from among a plurality of arm segments. The computing system further outputs a set of one or more movement commands for causing robot arm movement that includes relative movement between the first arm segment and a second arm segment via the first joint, and receiving a set of actuation data and a set of movement data associated with the first joint or the first arm segment. The computing system further determines, based on the set of actuation data and the set of movement data, at least one of: (i) a friction parameter estimate or (ii) a CoM estimate.
source_title: Method and computing system for estimating parameter for robot operation

abstract: Methods and systems are provided for controlling wheel-legged quadrupedal robots using pose optimization and force control according to quadratic programming (QP) are disclosed. An example robotic system leverages the whole-body motion and the wheel actuation to roll over high obstacles while keeping the wheel torques to navigate the terrain. Wheel traction and balancing is employed for the robot body. Linear rigid body dynamics with wheels are used for real-time balancing control of wheel-legged robots. Further, an effective pose optimization method is implemented for locomotion over steep ramp and stair terrains. The pose optimization solves for optimal poses to enhance stability and enforce collision-fee constraints for the rolling motion over stair terrain.
source_title: DESIGN AND CONTROL OF WHEEL-LEGGED ROBOTS NAVIGATING HIGH OBSTACLES

abstract: Stabilization system for robotic vehicles that provides protection against tipping over, where the robotic vehicle is equipped with robotic manipulator (8) on platform (7). The system comprises at least three outriggers (1) for expanding the working range of the robotic manipulator (8) based on the degree of the load it is exposed to and the shift of the center of mass of the robotic vehicle and its other parts that form the device as a whole with it, where each outrigger (1) is adapted for positioning along the vertical axis in relation to the ground and each of these outriggers (1) contains its own tensometric sensor (2) for measuring the force against the ground in the direction of the outrigger axis (1) for calculating a theoretical 3D model of the position of the center of mass of the device, while at least two outriggers (1) are positionable in the horizontal plane using a horizontal extension mechanisms (3). The system further comprises arithmetic computation unit (6) for controlling the positioning of the outriggers (1) and horizontal extension mechanisms (3), while the arithmetic computation unit (6) is further adapted for controlling the robotic manipulator (8), containing its own actuators, and for monitoring the information about the magnitude of forces from the tensometric sensors (2) in the outriggers (1). The arithmetic computation unit is configured for calculating a theoretical 3D model of the center of mass position given by all parts of the entire device by its 2D projection onto the stabilization pattern given by the current geometric position of the outriggers (1) resting against the ground at the ground level for the current and planned settings of all positionable parts of the device, including the robotic manipulator (8).
source_title: STABILIZATION SYSTEM FOR ROBOTIC VEHICLE WITH TIP-OVER PROTECTION

abstract: A sole exoskeleton capable of changing a walking gravity center track belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a bottom plate, a driving mechanism, a vertical elastic guide mechanism and a sole contact plate. The foot bottom contact plate is arranged above the bottom plate, two sets of driving mechanisms are arranged on the front portion and the rear portion of the bottom plate in the length direction of the foot respectively, the four sets of driving mechanisms are arranged in an array mode, the left portion and the right portion of the bottom plate are each provided with a set of vertical elastic guide mechanism, and the two sets of vertical elastic guide mechanisms are connected through a rotating shaft. The rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the plate surface of the plantar contact plate, and the four sets of driving mechanisms synchronously work to realize rotation of the plantar contact plate relative to the rotating shaft and vertical movement of the plantar contact plate relative to the bottom plate. The up-and-down fluctuation amplitude of the gravity center in the human walking process can be reduced, so that the power assisting position is equivalent to the gravity center, energy metabolism consumption of the whole body is reduced, and walking efficiency is improved.
source_title: Sole exoskeleton capable of changing walking gravity center track

abstract: A walking control apparatus of a robot includes a joint portion provided in each of a plurality of legs of the robot, a pose sensing unit to sense the pose of the robot, a walking state determination unit to determine a walking state from the pose of the robot, a knot point compensation value calculator to determine a Center Of Mass (COM) of the robot from the pose of the robot and to calculate a knot point compensation value, a desired angle trajectory generator to generate a reference knot point of the joint portion corresponding to the walking state, to compensate for the reference knot point using the knot point compensation value so as to generate a desired knot point, and to generate a desired angle trajectory of the joint portion using the desired knot point. The knot point which is the angle command of the joint portion of each of the legs to perform the next step is compensated for based on the COM, and the compensated desired knot point is smoothly connected using the spline curve such that the robot walks similar to a human. In addition, in order to maintain balance while walking, the angle of the joint portion of the intermediate point of the current step is fed back and the knot point of the next step is predicted and adjusted, such that the robot stably and smoothly walks.
source_title: Walking control apparatus of robot and method of controlling the same

abstract: The invention discloses a rigid-flexible pneumatic element hybrid drive robot joint system, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot has the whole-body joint movement function, and three air cylinders are connected in parallel to drive the waist joint to move. The cylinders of the waist joints and the pneumatic muscles of the pelvis drive the hip joints to move together; the pneumatic motor and the pneumatic muscle in the form of antagonistic muscle drive the knee joint to move together; the four pneumatic muscles are connected in parallel to drive the ankle joint to move, and the other two pneumatic muscles are connected with the lower ends of the feet through guiding of rear connecting shafts and drive the ankle joint together with the four pneumatic muscles of the ankle joint.
