The wrist joint-elbow joint and the shoulder joint-elbow joint are respectively provided with a group of antagonistic muscles to drive the elbow joint to rotate, the wrist joint-elbow joint and the wrist joint are provided with two groups of pneumatic muscles in the form of antagonistic muscles to drive the wrist joint to move, and the pneumatic claw has the effect of clamping articles. The joint is driven by the combination of pneumatic elements and mechanisms, and the joint has the advantages of being compact in structure, high in adaptability and flexible in working mode.
source_title: Rigid and flexible pneumatic element hybrid drive robot joint system

abstract: The invention discloses a robot control method based on gradient CPG with vestibular feedback, and the method comprises the steps: initializing hip and knee joint angles of a quadruped robot, enabling the quadruped robot to be at a standing balance position, and initializing all variables in a gradient CPG model; the output of the gradient CPG model serves as the input of the hip and knee joint angles of the quadruped robot, and the quadruped robot is controlled to start moving; and then real-time inclination angle information of the quadruped robot is transmitted to the gradient CPG model, so that the gradient CPG model performs signal response according to the real-time inclination angle information of the quadruped robot, a new control signal is output to control hip and knee joint angles of the quadruped robot, and motion control over the quadruped robot is completed. The method is high in solving efficiency and stability, and can be widely applied to the technical field of intelligent robot control.
source_title: Robot control method based on gradient CPG with vestibular feedback

abstract: The invention discloses a robot control method and system and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that a speed control instruction and action data of a reference object are obtained, the speed control instruction is used for controlling a moving mode to be adopted in a first moving area of the robot with the preset form, and the first moving area comprises the lower limbs and the waist of the robot with the preset form; the action data is used for determining actions to be executed in a second activity area of the preset form robot, and the second activity area comprises upper limbs of the preset form robot; based on the speed control instruction and the action data, determining a whole-body hybrid control mode of the robot in the preset form; and the robot in the preset form is controlled according to the whole-body mixed control mode. The technical problem that control precision and response flexibility are difficult to consider at the same time when robot control is carried out in the prior art is solved.
source_title: Robot control method and system and storage medium

abstract: A zero-moment-point control for a walking robot, using an RHC that permits a real-time optimal control calculation. A method of controlling a robot characterized by using, in combination, a path control that uses a zero-mome nt- point automatically generated in real time, and a non-linear control. A real time optimal control method for a walking robot, meeting the above requirements and being characterized by providing in real time an optimal target ZMP path when determining an optimal solution using uzmp(uz - g) = x( uz - g) - zux with a new input uzmp used for xzmp, where a zero-moment-point of a walking robot satisfies an equation restricting condition xzmp(uz - g) = x(u z - g) - zux.
source_title: REAL TIME OPTIMUM CONTROL METHOD FOR LEG-TYPE ROBOT

abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a location information guide platform including a direction display device, which enables a user to intuitively know the guiding direction of a direction indicator device that moves in the direction of a desired location, in the form of a kiosk installed in a specific location or in the form of a robot that can move on its own. A location information guide platform (100) including a direction display device comprises: a platform device unit (110) forming a housing body of a whole body; and a direction display device unit (120) installed in an upper end of the platform device unit (110) and indicating a direction to be guided.
source_title: LOCATION INFORMATION GUIDE PLATFORM WITH DIRECTION INDICATOR

abstract: The invention provides a panoramic navigation based mobile robot touch type teleoperation control method which adopts touch type teleoperation according to the panoramic picture of the whole body of the robot to remotely control the robot to realize efficient real-time reconnaissance. The panoramic navigation based mobile robot touch type teleoperation control method comprises the following steps:based on a visual sensing device mounted on the mobile robot, obtaining a current 360-degree panoramic picture of the whole body of the robot; inputting the current 360-degree panoramic picture intoa remote control terminal for display; clicking the any position of the 360-degree picture of the whole body of the robot displayed on the control terminal to obtain the angle difference of the current point and the robot heading direction; and based on the angle difference, controlling the mobile robot to turn to the position to further realize navigation control. The panoramic navigation based mobile robot touch type teleoperation control method is excellent in real-time performance and high in stability and wide in application range, is suitable for most of scenes and greatly lowers the controlling difficulty of a robot operator.
source_title: Panoramic navigation based mobile robot touch type teleoperation control method

abstract: The invention discloses a walking method and a gait planning method for a waist-driven quadruped robot, which are characterized in that a waist motor drives a waist structure to move and drives a front shoulder beam and a rear shoulder beam to move, so that relative movement of a leg structure relative to the whole body is formed; therefore, under the condition that a single leg of the quadruped robot only has one degree of freedom, the functions of straight movement, oblique walking, turning, gravity center adjustment and the like of the robot can be achieved. Flexible movement of the quadruped robot can be achieved in a simple and efficient mode, and the complexity of the robot structure and the control difficulty are reduced.
source_title: Waist-driven quadruped robot walking method and gait planning method

abstract: The invention provides a suspension type anti-falling robot. The suspension type anti-falling robot comprises a ceiling device and a robot body connected to the ceiling device; the ceiling device is used for suspending the robot body on the roof, so that the robot body can be suspended in the air, the ceiling device at least provides bearing support in the vertical direction and can drive the robot body to at least move in the horizontal direction, or move in the horizontal direction and the vertical direction and rotate in the horizontal direction, and an anti-falling assembly is arranged onthe robot body and is used for detecting the falling tendency of a human body, controlling the ceiling device to enable the robot body to get close to the human body and providing support for preventing or weakening the falling tendency. The suspension type anti-falling robot has the advantages that under the condition that a user is unstable or loses balance and tends to fall over, the existing standing balance stability problem of a standing type robot can be solved, and the floor space is not occupied.
source_title: Suspension type anti-falling robot

abstract: The invention provides a curved surface intelligent spraying model training method, a spraying method and a system thereof, and relates to the technical field of robot path planning. The intelligent curved surface spraying method comprises the steps that point cloud data of an object are collected through a depth camera; carrying out voxel filtering, statistical filtering and RANSAC plane segmentation preprocessing on the point cloud data in sequence; calculating the center of mass and the PCA principal component direction of the preprocessed point cloud, and carrying out rasterizing division on the space where the point cloud is located according to a preset grid size and the number of rows and columns to generate a grid map; performing path planning by using a DQN model; and the robot carries out spraying operation according to the planned path. The invention further provides a curved surface intelligent spraying model training method and a curved surface intelligent spraying system so as to cover all spraying areas with the optimal path and avoid invalid movement.
source_title: Curved surface intelligent spraying model training method, spraying method and system thereof

abstract: The embodiment of the invention is suitable for the field of machine vision, and provides a visual positioning method, a robot control method, related equipment and a medium, and the visual positioning method comprises the steps: collecting a data stream through a visual sensor, the data stream comprising an RGB image, a depth image and a point cloud, and the data stream comprising data of a to-be-positioned target object; determining a target point cloud corresponding to the target object from the point clouds according to the RGB image and the depth image; determining the center of mass and the main direction of the target object according to the target point cloud; and positioning the target object according to the center of mass and the main direction. Through the method, the difficulty of visual positioning can be reduced, and the accuracy of visual positioning can be improved.
source_title: Visual positioning method, robot control method, related equipment and medium

abstract: Disclosed herein a method of controlling the balance of a walking robot. In the method, a location and an acceleration of a center of gravity of the walking robot are detected in a three-dimensional (3D) x, y, z coordinate system. A location of a Zero Moment Point (ZMP) on an xy plane is detected using the location of the center of gravity and the acceleration of the center of gravity in x- and y-axis directions. Walking of the walking robot is controlled so that the ZMP is located inside a stable area including a bottom of a foot of the walking robot on the xy plane.
source_title: METHOD OF CONTROLLING BALANCE OF WALKING ROBOT

abstract: A legged mobile robot gives up a normal walking motion and starts a tumbling motion when an excessively high external force or external moment is applied thereto and a behavior plan of a foot part thereof is disabled. At this time, the variation amount DELTA S/ DELTA t of the area S of a support polygon of the body per time t is minimized and the support polygon when the body drops onto a floor is maximized to distribute an impact which acts upon the body from the floor when the body drops onto the floor to the whole body to suppress the damage to the body to the minimum. Further, the legged mobile robot autonomously restores a standing up posture from an on-floor posture thereof such as a supine posture or a prone posture. <IMAGE>
source_title: Operation control device for leg-type mobile robot and operation control method and robot device

abstract: The invention provides a robot control method and system. The method comprises the steps that hand posture information is obtained based on a first positioning device, and body posture information is obtained based on a second positioning device; according to the hand position and posture information and the body position and posture information, whether the relative posture of the hand relative to the body is changed or not is determined; if yes, the active pose transformation amount of the hand relative to the body is calculated according to the hand pose information and the body pose information, and the target chassis pose of the movable chassis is calculated according to the hand pose information and the body pose information; calculating a target mechanical arm pose of the mechanical arm according to the active pose transformation amount; and according to the target mechanical arm pose and the target chassis pose, a first control instruction and a second control instruction are generated correspondingly. Decoupling control over the mechanical arm and the chassis is achieved, and the stability and accuracy of whole-body control of the robot are improved.
source_title: Robot control method and system

abstract: The invention discloses a whole-body response planning control method for a mobile operation robot based on quadratic programming, and firstly provides a tail end track re-planning method combined with visual information. A tail end track is parameterized by using a B-spline curve, and a control point of the B-spline curve is corrected according to environment information, so that correction of a reference track in a certain time domain in the future is realized. Then, a reactivity optimization controller based on quadratic programming is provided for whole-body control, and safe and smooth collaborative movement of the mobile operation arm is achieved by combining safety constraint derived by a control barrier function and operability cost. Besides, by introducing a slack variable and punishing the slack variable, the instantaneous error of the reactive controller is allowed, the deviation target value is punished at the same time, the tracking adaptability and accuracy are improved, and the algorithm provided by the invention improves the potential of operation smoothness, safety and accuracy in an uncertain environment.
source_title: Moving operation robot whole body reaction planning control method based on quadratic programming

abstract: The invention discloses a portable wearable power-assisted exoskeleton robot, and relates to the field of wearable robots, the portable wearable power-assisted exoskeleton robot comprises an upper limb mechanism, a lower limb mechanism, a back connecting plate and a mounting box, the upper limb assembly comprises a first shoulder back plate, a second shoulder back plate, a rotating plate, a big arm plate, a first driving piece, a small arm plate, a second driving piece, a power transmission piece, a big arm binding plate and a small arm binding plate; the second driving part used for driving the elbow joint to rotate is fixedly installed on the back connecting plate, the second driving frame drives the small arm plate to assist the elbow joint to rotate through the power transmission part, the situation that the second driving part is directly placed at the elbow joint is avoided, meanwhile, the weight of the elbow joint is reduced through the unique elbow joint design, and therefore the burden of the first driving part is reduced; the boosting effect is improved; the power-assisted exoskeleton robot can transmit main loads of the upper limb mechanisms and the back connecting plate to the ground through the lower limb mechanisms, and part of the loads are evenly borne by the whole body.
source_title: Portable wearable power-assisted exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention relates to a bionic robot comprising a main body, whole body skeleton tissues, whole body skin tissues, whole body fat tissues, a fixed body inner cavity, a control unit and a movable body inner cavity. The whole body skeleton tissues are installed inside the main body, the outer side of the main body is wrapped with the whole body skin tissues, the fixed body inner cavity is fixed inside the head position of the main body, the control unit is installed inside the fixed body inner cavity, and the movable body inner cavity is installed at the position, close to the fixed body inner cavity, inside a chest of the main body. By means of the bionic robot, a telescopic skeleton structure is designed, threaded rods are controlled by motors to rotate, extension rods of the upper andlower limb skeletons are in threaded connection with the threaded rods, and therefore the extension rods can stretch out and draw back, and different body heights and widths can be simulated conveniently; and in addition, the whole body skeleton tissues are made of high-performance aluminum alloys, reinforced plastic and the like, the strength is high, the weight is small, and damage is not proneto being caused.
source_title: Bionic robot

abstract: The invention discloses an accompanying robot. An upper computer PCB for human-computer interaction is arranged in a head part of the robot; a main body part is provided with a head rotating motor for driving the head part to rotate in the horizontal plane by 360 degrees; a foot part is provided with a battery pack and a foot motor connected with the battery pack; the foot motor is connected with a driving wheel to drive the whole robot to move and rotate on the ground; multiple infrared obstacle avoiding sensors and multiple capacitance touch sensors are arranged on the whole body of the robot; and the main body part is provided with a lower computer PCB for acquiring and processing data of various sensors. The robot has multiple human-computer interaction functions such as listening, talking and chatting; the robot is touched to trigger multiple expressions of joy, anger, sorrow and happiness; the robot can detect and avoid obstacles in the moving process; a mobile phone APP terminal and a cloud server can be used for controlling all behaviors of the robot; and in addition, the robot also has a projection function.
source_title: Accompanying robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot and a fixing method of the robot. The robot comprises a robot body; the executing mechanism is connected with the robot body and used for executing corresponding functions of the robot; the lifting mechanism is connected with the robot body; the suction cup is connected with the robot body through the lifting mechanism, and the lifting mechanism is used for descending the suction cup in a working posture, so that the suction cup is in contact with an environment interface; the suction cup is used for fixing the robot and the environment interface when the robot is in the working posture; and the controller is used for calculating the mass center of the robot in real time along with the action of the executing mechanism in the working posture and controlling the suction force of the suction cup according to the change of the mass center. The robot can change the fixed force according to the change of the center of mass, so that the stability of the robot is improved.
source_title: Robot and robot fixing method

abstract: The invention provides a diversion tunnel maintenance robot, and relates to the field of robots. The maintenance robot is composed of a robot body, a hanging basket, a control box and a cable assembly, and the robot body is placed in the hanging basket; the cable assembly is connected with the robot body and the control box through cables separately, and the control box is connected with a power source through a cable; and the power source is used for providing electric energy for the robot body and the control box. A front camera, a rear camera and a light are arranged on the robot, and therefore the situation that the whole body of the robot can be clearly seen without a light source is achieved, and meanwhile images can be formed by the cameras to show for operators through a display screen; the position of external equipment is changed through a sliding rail; the internal condition of a diversion tunnel is scanned through a three-dimensional laser scanner; and the maintenance robot is conveyed to a detection position through the hanging basket, and an operator on the maintenance robot controls the maintenance robot to run towards the diversion tunnel for detection and maintenance. According to the robot, detection of the diversion tunnel can be effectively completed, the risk of the operators is reduced, and the detection reliability is improved.
source_title: Diversion tunnel maintenance robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot, a control method and device of the robot and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of control engineering.The robot comprises a base, a series-parallel connection type mechanical arm, a sensor, a storage and a processor, and the processor is used for executing computer readable instructions stored in the storage; data information, collected by a sensor, of the base and the mechanical arm is obtained, and the current state of the base and the equivalent series configuration state of the mechanical arm are obtained; then, the current overall configuration of the robot is obtained, and the expected overall configuration of the robot corresponding to the task instruction is obtained according to the current overall configuration of the robot and the whole-body motion control algorithm; and the base and the mechanical arm are controlled to move, so that the robot is in an expected overall configuration. Due to the fact that the connecting structure of the mechanical arms in the robot is in a series-parallel connection type, the stability of the robot in the moving process can be improved, and the load capacity of the robot can be remarkably improved.
source_title: Robot, control method and equipment thereof and medium

abstract: A motion data generating system for a robot including a waist and a leg, comprising: a test subject motion data acquiring unit that acquires captured waist motion data from motion of a leg separated from motion of a test subject; a representative point extracting unit that performs peak detection by smoothing the captured leg motion data; a scale converting unit that converts the capture leg motion data and the capture waist motion data at a representative point into a scale of the robot; a ZMP setting unit that sets a target zero moment point (ZMP of the robot; an interpolation generating unit that generates an attitude of the leg and the waist of the robot by interpolation; and a motion data generating unit that generates motion data in which the attitude of the leg and the waist is corrected so as to satisfy a target ZMP.
source_title: Motion data generating system for robot, motion data generating method for robot, and storage medium

abstract: The invention relates to a medical assistance mobile robot with an instrument disinfection structure. The medical assistance mobile robot comprises a body, a fixed plate and an L-shaped fixed block. Atransmission mechanism is connected to the inner wall of the body, and a chassis is distributed at the lower end of the body. The fixed plate is arranged at the upper end top of the transmission mechanism, and a cooling structure is connected to the top end of the middle of the fixed plate. The L-shaped fixed block is attached to the middle inner wall of the body, and a sliding rail is arranged at the top of the L-shaped fixed block. A box is arranged at the top end of the sliding rail, and a partition is placed on the inner wall of the box. A cushion layer is attached to the inner wall of the box. Through the arrangement of the body and the chassis, the two sides of the chassis are distributed in an arc-face-shaped mode, the whole body and the chassis serve as a bearing fixing structureof the whole medical assistance mobile robot and are connected together in a welded mode, connection strength is high, and the condition that the whole equipment is not liable to breakage and fallingduring use can be ensured effectively during use.
source_title: Medical assistance mobile robot with instrument disinfection structure

abstract: The invention discloses a control method of a foot type robot. The control method comprises the following steps of: acquiring a movement instruction of the foot type robot, and determining a ground movement track corresponding to the movement instruction; determining the rotation angle of each joint according to the ground movement track; acquiring the initial position of the foot type robot, and determining the ground track of each connecting rod according to the initial position and the rotation angle of each joint; and according to the rotation angle of each joint, the ground movement track and the ground track of each connecting rod, determining the speed, the acceleration and the force of each joint and the speed, the acceleration and the force of each connecting rod so as to control the foot type robot. The rotation angle of each joint is determined through the ground movement track, and then the ground track of each connecting rod is determined according to the initial position and the rotation angle of each joint, so that the speed, the acceleration and the force of each joint and the speed, the acceleration and the force of each connecting rod can be obtained, the whole body of the foot type robot is modeled, the dynamic characteristics of the robot are expressed to the greatest extent, and the dynamic performance of the robot is improved.
source_title: Control method of foot type robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of ship cargo cleaning, and discloses a ship cargo cleaning robot which comprises a base, walking wheels are arranged on the two sides of the base, a fixing seat is fixedly connected to the top of the base, an illumination mechanism is arranged on the top of the fixing seat, and a supporting mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top of the base. And a cleaning mechanism is arranged on one side of the supporting mechanism. According to the ship cargo cleaning robot, through continuous back-and-forth swinging of the cleaning disc, the whole body of ship cargo can be uniformly cleaned, the ship cargo cleaning range is expanded, and therefore the ship cargo surface cleaning effect is improved; the cleaning disc can be electrically driven to move, manual adjustment is not needed, manual operation is replaced by electric operation, the working efficiency of the cleaning disc is improved, and a user can use the cleaning disc conveniently.
source_title: Ship cargo cleaning robot

abstract: The invention provides a control method and device for an intelligent robot with a body, a terminal and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot autonomous task planning and motion control. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode prompt information of a to-be-controlled robot; based on a large-scale pre-training language model, multi-modal prompt information and an atomic skill library suitable for robot long-sequence whole-body linkage actions, generating a corresponding chain reasoning text when a to-be-controlled robot executes task description, and decomposing the task description into atomic skill calling sequences according to the chain reasoning text, the atomic skill calling sequence comprises a plurality of atomic skills according to a calling sequence; and after calling and activating the atomic skills one by one according to the calling sequence, controlling the to-be-controlled robot to execute the atomic skills according to the calling sequence. According to the invention, seamless connection of whole-body motion and local operation of the robot can be realized, so that the robot can efficiently complete a long-sequence task in a complex environment.
source_title: Control method and device for intelligent robot with body, terminal and storage medium

abstract: A robotic animal puzzle is assembled from flat board pieces. The robotic animal includes a head portion. The head portion includes a neck group, a torso portion, including a holder 15 for an optional battery, multiple leg portions, and a tail portion. Those pieces and groups are connected using either interlocking mechanisms or flexible linkages to form the robotic animal-shaped puzzle. Movement and gestures may be controlled by an externally connected processor powered by an on-board battery pack. A pull and drag mechanism is provided to conveniently tune the center of mass. Slots allow the screw that connects the battery holder to slide.
source_title: Robotic animal puzzle

abstract: The invention provides a centroid estimation and compensation method and system for a variable-configuration quadruped robot with an arm, and relates to the technical field of quadruped robot motion planning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the state feedback information of the variable-configuration quadruped robot in the motion process; on the basis of the state feedback information, foot end contact force of the supporting legs is calculated through a whole-body dynamic model of the variable-configuration quadruped robot and a disturbance force observer based on generalized momentum; according to the foot end contact force of the supporting leg, adopting a centroid estimation algorithm of an online recursive strategy to estimate a centroid deviation value after unknown disturbance; according to the estimated centroid deviation value, a motion trail planner and a centroid dynamical model are adjusted, centroid deviation compensation is conducted through a whole body controller of the null space based on the adjusted result, the optimal joint torque is obtained, and real-time servo control is conducted; according to the invention, stable control of the quadruped robot under disturbance of internal force or external force such as double-arm movement, leg configuration change and unknown load is realized.
source_title: Method and system for estimating and compensating mass center of variable-configuration quadruped robot with arm

abstract: The invention discloses a whole body wearable exoskeleton robot capable of achieving high-precision assembly, and relates to the technical field of exoskeleton robots. The whole body wearable exoskeleton robot capable of achieving high-precision assembly is divided into an upper part and a lower part, the upper half part comprises a back fixing device, shoulder joint executing mechanisms, large arm connecting rods, elbow joint executing mechanisms, small arm connecting rods, a single-side laser baffle and a single-side fixing handle; and the lower half part comprises a waist fixing device, hip joint executing mechanisms, thigh connecting rods, knee joint executing mechanisms, shank connecting rods, ankle joint executing mechanisms and soles. By means of the whole body wearable exoskeleton robot, a laser sensor is adopted for precise positioning, manual labor is replaced by machinery in a proper occasion to complete repeated work, and high-precision assembling work, moving and overturning tasks are achieved.
source_title: Whole body wearable exoskeleton robot capable of achieving high-precision assembly

abstract: The invention discloses a robot leg joint force velocity pre-matching method, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, setting the overall total mass of a robot system needing to be designed, constructing a hybrid spring model of a single-mass rigid body, and obtaining simple substance point and foothold tracks and three-dimensional force externally acted by a supporting point through a dynamic simulation balance motion process; secondly, planning a lifting and treading movement track between two footholds for the swinging leg, so as to obtain a simplified dynamic movement track; by constructing whole-body inverse kinematics optimization, the dynamic motion trails are mapped into all joint angles and angular velocity time sequences of legs of the legged robot; and finally, the three-dimensional force of the supporting point is mapped to the joint torque through Jacobian obtained through the leg angle. By means of the method, the problem that at the beginning of design of a robot system, due to the fact that mechanical structures of all limbs are not shaped and kinetic parameters are unknown, joint driving checking is complex and difficult can be solved.
source_title: Robot leg joint force velocity pre-matching method

abstract: The invention discloses a gait control method and a device for a dual-foot robot. The method comprises the steps of selecting gait control parameters for a starting period, a walking period and a stopping period; acquiring the motion trajectory of the mass center of the dual-foot robot during the walking period when the zero moment point of the dual-foot robot is within a stable area; obtaining the first value of each gait control parameter when the mass center is at the initial moment of the walking period and the second value of the gait control parameter when the mass center is at the ending moment of the walking period; setting a first constraint condition at the ending moment of the starting period by utilizing the first value, and setting a second constraint condition at the starting moment of the stopping period by utilizing the second value; based on the first constraint condition and the second constraint condition, calculating the motion trajectory of the mass center during the starting period and during the stopping period respectively; controlling the walking of the dual-foot robot to enable the motion trajectory of the mass center of the dual-foot robot during walking to meet the motion trajectory of the mass center during the starting period, the walking period and the stopping period respectively. According to the technical scheme of the invention, the stable cohesion of the dual-foot robot during the starting period, the walking period and the stopping period and the walking stability of the dual-foot robot can be ensured.
source_title: Gait control method and device for dual-foot robot

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robot device capable of turning its face into a direction of sound source by natural motion by cooperation of the whole body.

SOLUTION: When a movable scope of a neck of the robot device 1 is ±Y degrees and a relative angle in the direction of sound source S is the direction of X degrees for the direction of the front of the robot device 1, the robot device 1 rotates the whole body trunk by only X-Y degrees using leg parts and rotates a neck revolute joint yaw axis in the direction of sound source S by only Y degrees to turn its face into the direction of sound source S. When the robot device 1 finds a previously learned face of a person that it knows and discriminates that it is called by the person from information of an image inputting device, it rotates its body trunk by Y degrees, rotates the neck revolute joint yaw axis by -Y degrees, eliminates twist of its neck while seeing an object with attention, and faces the direction of sound source S by natural motion.
