source_title: ROBOT DEVICE AND MOTION CONTROL METHOD THEREFOR

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of leg-arm collaborative robots, and provides a leg-arm collaborative robot dancing track generation and tracking control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a dancing motion of a leg-arm collaborative robot animation model in animation software; performing trajectory extraction and trajectory optimization on the dance movement to obtain a trunk, a mechanical arm, a mechanical leg foot end trajectory and a sole force which accord with robot dynamics; after the tasks of the trunk, the mechanical arms and the mechanical legs are subjected to priority grading, through null-space mapping, the positions, the speeds and the accelerated speeds of the tasks of all levels are calculated; based on the acceleration of each level of task and the sole force of the mechanical leg end, after relaxation optimization of a trunk kinetic equation of the leg-arm collaborative robot, joint torque is obtained through a whole-body kinetic equation of the robot, the control rate of the joint torque is obtained in combination with the position and speed of each level of task, and dance motion reproduction is completed. The trajectory generation efficiency is improved, and the robot can reproduce the dance action as much as possible on the premise of being stable.
source_title: Track generation and tracking control method and system for dancing of leg-arm collaborative robot

abstract: A robotic first responder system provides injured patients with first response medical care and extracts the injured patient from a dangerous or remote area. After assessing of the level of consciousness of an injured patient, the robotic unit utilizes an inflatable immobilization device for safe robotic rescue of injured patients. The robotic unit lifts and transfers an injured patient to an extraction vehicle, a secure, bullet-proof wheeled system that can be pulled by the robot to safe location. The extraction vehicle continues serving as the evacuation stretcher to a medical station. The robotic unit utilizes zero moment point control to maintain stability while lifting the patient. A robot first responder tows the extraction vehicle or the extraction vehicle self-navigates incorporating with power drive and autonomous navigation systems.
source_title: Robotic First Responder System and Method

abstract: The invention relates to a model prediction control method for active obstacle avoidance of a bionic snakelike robot, and aims to minimize a tracking error and ensure that the whole body does not collide with an obstacle under the assumption conditions that the physical constraint of a real robot is met and the change speed of a joint angle is low in the process of deducing a simplified average system of the snakelike robot. Establishing a target function; and solving a group of optimal solutions for control according to the speed and direction errors and the distance between each connecting rod of the snake body and the obstacle. The actual distance between all connecting rods of the snake body and an obstacle is considered, so that all joints are prevented from colliding with the obstacle, and the stability and obstacle avoidance behavior conflict are effectively coordinated; the amplitude of the snakelike robot is adjusted in real time, the needed steering angle is reduced by reducing the amplitude in the gait when the snakelike robot faces an obstacle, and unnecessary energy loss is reduced; small-angle obstacle avoidance is carried out, the steering space is reduced, and an expected path is rapidly returned after an obstacle avoidance task is completed; and the problems of discontinuous turning gait, unstable performance and the like after the steering angle is suddenly increased are solved.
source_title: Model prediction control method for active obstacle avoidance of bionic snakelike robot

abstract: The invention discloses a nuclear facility decommissioning robot obstacle avoidance trajectory planning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring environmental data through a solid-state laser radar and a binocular camera, and establishing a three-dimensional point cloud map based on a three-dimensional mapping and positioning algorithm; determining the distance from an obstacle to the current center of mass of the robot through a binocular camera at the front part of the robot based on an SGBM algorithm; converting a global Cartesian coordinate system, extracting two-dimensional plane coordinates of all point clouds, and screening out obstacle point clouds in boundaries by taking two linear equations as boundaries; generating an effective boundary curve of the obstacle at the current moment; local candidate tracks of the robot are generated through scattering point sampling and quintic polynomial track fitting; and the effective boundary of the obstacle at each moment is dynamically solved, so that the optimal movement track at the current moment is planned until the robot bypasses the obstacle. According to the method, the problem that the distance between the robot and the surrounding environment is difficult to determine when the current nuclear decommissioning robot needs to depend on manual remote operation through monitoring videos in the obstacle avoidance process is solved, the burden of manual operation is relieved, and the obstacle avoidance efficiency and accuracy are also improved.
source_title: Nuclear facility decommissioning robot obstacle avoidance trajectory planning method

abstract: The invention relates to the field of exoskeleton robots, in particular to a modular reconfigurable multifunctional exoskeleton robot. The modular reconfigurable multifunctional exoskeleton robot comprises a track indoor environment, a multi-degree-of-freedom supporting frame and a whole-body exoskeleton device, wherein the track indoor environment is an open space; a track is arranged on the ground of the track indoor environment; the multi-degree-of-freedom supporting frame is arranged on the track, and translational movement of the multi-degree-of-freedom supporting frame in the axial direction of the whole-body exoskeleton device is achieved; the whole-body exoskeleton device is fixedly connected with the multi-degree-of-freedom supporting frame; the multi-degree-of-freedom supportingframe drives the whole-body exoskeleton device to do translational movement in the axial direction of the track; and the whole-body exoskeleton device achieves translation, pitching and rotation movement relative to the multi-degree-of-freedom supporting frame. The modular reconfigurable multifunctional exoskeleton robot is suitable for multiple visual specific application environments, diversified in functional structure, modular and reconfigurable, and a highly modular reconfigurable multifunctional exoskeleton robot system can be used in combination with a multi-degree-of-freedom rehabilitation auxiliary supporting device to achieve various requirement functions and the rehabilitation effect of approaching closer to the reality.
source_title: Modular reconfigurable multifunctional exoskeleton robot

abstract: The invention provides a robot motion control method and device, a controller and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the steps that a whole-body angular momentum vector of a robot in each posture is calculated according to a pre-planned whole-body motion track of the robot; according to the whole-body angular momentum vector of each posture, the whole-body angular momentum vector of the posture before each posture and a preset time interval, the angular momentum change rate of the robot in each posture is calculated, and the preset time interval is the time interval between every two adjacent postures; a target centroid track of the robot is calculated according to the angular momentum change rate and a pre-planned zero moment point track of the robot; and motion control is performed on the robot according to the target centroid track. According to the robot motion control method and device, the controller and the storage medium, the walking stability of the robot can be improved.
source_title: Robot motion control method and device, controller and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a motion control method for adjusting a slide block of a centroid mechanism in a reconstruction process of a transformation robot, which comprises the following steps: 1, establishing a transformation robot model, 2, inputting the deviation between an expected zero moment point and an actual zero moment point into a Fuzzy-PID controller, and calculating and outputting expected displacement of the slide block, 3, carrying out anti-impact rapid motion planning on the expected displacement, and 4, carrying out anti-impact rapid motion planning on the expected displacement. 4, inputting the deviation between the expected speed and the actual speed into an integral sliding mode controller, and calculating and outputting a sliding block control voltage; 5, inputting the control voltage into an electromechanical dynamics model to obtain the actual speed, and feeding back the actual speed to the integral sliding mode controller to realize smooth closed-loop control; 6, integrating the speed to obtain displacement; and a zero moment point is calculated by utilizing displacement and is fed back to the Fuzzy-PID controller to form stability closed-loop control. According to the method, multi-target comprehensive control can be carried out on the displacement and speed of the movement of the sliding block, so that the sliding block quickly reaches an expected position on the premise of no impact, and the reconstruction stability of the transformation robot can be effectively improved.
source_title: Motion control method for adjusting sliding block of centroid mechanism in reconstruction process of transformation robot

abstract: According to the multi-task robot sensing method based on deep learning disclosed by the embodiment of the invention, a deep learning sensing method based on images is adopted, and compared with a high-cost laser radar sensing method, the cost is greatly saved. According to the embodiment of the invention, under the condition that the computing power of a robot system is limited, a lightweight and efficient network is used, feature extraction information is shared, a multi-task model of human body posture estimation, target detection and instance segmentation is realized, and the sensing ability of the robot is improved. Wherein the human body posture estimation can determine whether a person exists around the robot or not and judge the motion state of the person, such as the foot direction; target detection can determine whether obstacles exist around the robot or not; the instance segmentation can help the robot to better position and better deal with the obstacle shielding problem. Besides, the network adopted in the embodiment of the invention simplifies the attitude estimation of the key points of the whole body, improves the reasoning speed, and alleviates the problem of human missing detection under the fisheye camera of the robot.
source_title: Multi-task robot sensing method based on deep learning

abstract: The invention relates to a multifunctional robot for sitting-standing mobility assistance and rehabilitation exercise training and belongs to the field of machinery. The multifunctional robot for sitting-standing mobility assistance and rehabilitation exercise training comprises a top hanger device, support oblique beams, support inner tubes, a master control transmission box, armrest cross beams,armrest supports, base main beams, moving support rods and the like. Weight-reduced assisted sitting-standing protection and rehabilitation exercise training are achieved through the two transmissiondevices, a lower limb correction assist exoskeleton structure fixed to legs and a top dumbbell-like spiral reel unit, under driving of a central control motor. According to kinematic analysis, underclinical bid data statistics, for lower limb joints, shoulder points and body center of mass during body stand-up, a user with lower limb mobility difficulties can gain sitting-standing mobility assistance at the premise of meeting ergonomics, rehabilitation training can be performed on lower limb muscles in complete standard accordance with correct force exertion plans of muscles during stand-upof a healthy body, abnormal force exertion of muscles due to distortion of stand-up attitude is avoided, and therefore, safe and healthy exercise rehabilitation training is achieved.
source_title: Multifunctional robot for sitting-standing mobility assistance and rehabilitation exercise training

abstract: The invention provides a full-automatic bath and nursing robot. Spray scrubbing heads are arranged on a back scrubbing device and a hip scrubbing device and are of circular structures. Circular channels are formed in the spray scrubbing heads, water spraying holes are evenly formed in each circular channel, it is guaranteed that the parts, needing to be emphatically cleaned, of the back and the hip can be completely cleaned, and the waterflow sprayed by the water spray holes in the circular channels is smooth and mild; massage protrusions which protrude outwards are arranged on the spray scrubbing heads, shower lotion extrusion heads are arranged in the middles of the massage protrusions, a user extrudes the shower lotion extrusion heads when sitting on the back scrubbing device and the hip scrubbing device, shower lotion can be automatically extruded to coat the back and hip, the waterflow sprayed by the water spray holes in the circular channels is used for washing, and bath washingfor the whole body is achieved; the spray scrubbing heads are movably installed on arc elastic strips and can rotate and conduct rotation scrubbing motion on the arc elastic strips, and the robot hasthe functions of automatic bath, scrubbing, massage and health care.
source_title: Full-automatic bath and nursing robot

abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical arm operation and whole body coordination stability control method. The method comprises the steps: acquiring weight position information and lifting target position information of a weight; planning a motion path of the weight; according to the sensing information of all joints of the mechanical arm, acquiring the weight of the heavy object and the real-time torque of the mechanical arm in real time; fusing the tail end load of the mechanical arm to map to the mass center of the robot; and controlling the whole-body coordination stability of the robot according to the mapped centroid. The method has the advantages of being high in stability and convenient to use.
source_title: Mechanical arm operation and whole body coordination stability control method

abstract: An example implementation for determining mechanically-timed footsteps may involve a robot having a first foot in contact with a ground surface and a second foot not in contact with the ground surface. The robot may determine a position of its center of mass and center of mass velocity, and based on these, determine a capture point for the robot. The robot may also determine a threshold position for the capture point, where the threshold position is based on a target trajectory for the capture point after the second foot contacts the ground surface. The robot may determine that the capture point has reached this threshold position and based on this determination, cause the second foot to contact the ground surface.
source_title: Mechanically-timed footsteps for a robotic device

abstract: The disclosure provides a motion control system of a robot and a robot, wherein the robot is a wheel-foot composite robot which comprises a robot body and a motion mechanism arranged on the robot body; the motion mechanism comprises two rear rollers and two front leg mechanisms; the system comprises a motion planning module configured to determine a first, second and third motion tasks based on the target task and the latest actual state information of the wheel-foot composite robot; the motion control module config to control the whole body motion of the wheel-foot composite robot based on the first, second and third motion tasks; the state perception module configured to determine actual state information of the wheel-foot composite robot, and sending the actual state information to the motion planning module, so that the motion planning module performs new motion planning based on the actual state information.
source_title: MOTION CONTROL SYSTEM OF ROBOT AND ROBOT

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: determining a zero moment point measurement value of the robot; selecting a target anti-interference strategy subset corresponding to the zero moment point measurement value from a preset anti-interference strategy set; and controlling the robot according to the target anti-interference strategy subset. According to the application, a plurality of different anti-interference strategies form an anti-interference strategy set, in the walking process of the robot, the optimal anti-interference strategy subset can be selected from the zero moment point measurement values of the robot, and the robot is controlled according to the strategy subset. And the robot can be flexibly switched among various complex interference scenes.
source_title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a robot track determining method and device, a robot, a medium and a program product, the robot comprises a robot body, robot feet and a mechanical arm, and the robot feet and the mechanical arm form motion branch chains with the robot body respectively; the method comprises the steps that a state variable, a control variable and state information of the tail ends of all motion branch chains and a target object in the process that a robot is expected to complete a target task are obtained, and the state information is used for representing whether the tail ends of the motion branch chains make contact with the target object or not; constructing an evaluation model according to the state variable, the control variable and the state information; according to the evaluation model, a reference track meeting preset constraints is determined, the reference track is used for controlling the robot to complete the target task, the current situation of leg-arm separation control is broken through, and therefore the whole-body coordination of the robot is improved when the robot is controlled to complete the target task according to the reference track.
source_title: Robot trajectory determination method and device, robot, medium and program product

abstract: A robot manipulator comprises a base (102 figure 1); an arm (1108, 112 figure 1) connected to the base (102 figure 1) via at least a shoulder joint (110 figure 1); and a control system comprising a dynamic stability determination module configured to determine whether a dynamic stability criterion is met. If the dynamic stability criterion is met, the arm is configured to respond compliantly to an applied force; and if the dynamic stability criterion is not met, the control system is configured to cause motion of the base in the direction of the applied force. Dynamic stability of the robot manipulator is maintained if unexpected external forces are experienced. The robot manipulator may be a 3D cleaning device. The dynamic stability determination module may determine whether the dynamic stability criterion is met based on the determined location of the zero moment point (ZMP) of the robot manipulator. The dynamic stability criterion may be that the ZMP is located above a region bounded by a predetermined support region boundary C1, C2 or above a point within the region which is at least a threshold distance from the boundary C1, C2.
source_title: Dynamic stability of a robot manipulator

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-contact-point force distribution method and system for racemization of an operation target of a multi-wheel-arm robot, and the method comprises the steps: achieving the enveloping of the target through the cooperative adjustment of the configuration of three mechanical arms of the multi-wheel-arm robot, and enabling all-directional controllable damping wheels at the tail ends of the mechanical arms to be in contact with the surface of the target; in the passive following mode, the arm force of each mechanical arm is dynamically planned, each omni-directional controllable damping wheel is controlled to rotate along with a target, and safe and smooth contact between the multi-wheel-arm robot and the target is achieved; and in the active racemization mode, arm power of each mechanical arm and friction torque of each omni-directional controllable damping wheel are dynamically planned, the omni-directional controllable damping wheels apply friction force, target angular momentum is released, and target racemization is achieved. According to the invention, the whole body smooth contact and stable racemization of the target are realized.
source_title: Multi-contact-point force distribution method and system for racemization of operation target of multi-wheel-arm robot

abstract: The invention relates to the field of underwater swimming mechanical arm path planning, in particular to an energy consumption optimal path planning algorithm of an underwater swimming mechanical arm in a complex environment, and discloses a multi-joint underwater swimming mechanical arm path planning scheme based on a double-layer RRT * path planning framework. According to the first-layer path planning, on the basis of a Q-RRT * algorithm, random sampling points are obtained by combining Gaussian and an artificial potential field method, and the convergence speed is further increased by using an I < nform >-RRT * node rejection strategy; according to the second layer of path planning, whole-body obstacle avoidance and energy consumption of the underwater swimming mechanical arm are considered on the basis of the first layer, and the path planning of the underwater swimming mechanical arm with the optimal energy is obtained through a large number of iterations. According to the method, the calculated amount of path planning is remarkably reduced, the method is suitable for path planning of most multi-joint robots, and the method is easy to implement in actual engineering application.
source_title: Optimal energy consumption path planning algorithm for underwater swimming mechanical arm in complex environment

abstract: The multi-section bionic caterpillar robot comprises a bent body module, and sensing modules are arranged at the two ends of the bent body module; the bending body module comprises a plurality of six-degree-of-freedom parallel structures which are connected in series end to end, and each six-degree-of-freedom parallel structure is provided with a sole suction cup; the six-degree-of-freedom parallel structure comprises a movable platform and a static platform, the movable platform is connected with one end of a connecting rod assembly, the other end of the connecting rod assembly is connected with a power piece, the power piece is installed on the static platform, and the sole suction cup is installed on the static platform. According to the bionic caterpillar robot, the connecting rod assembly is made to move through the power piece, then the horizontal distance between the movable platform and the static platform connected with the movable platform through the connecting rod assembly is shortened, the next six-degree-of-freedom parallel structure is pulled, the whole body is pushed forwards, and bionic wriggling of the bionic caterpillar robot is achieved; therefore, the moth-imitating robot can flexibly and stably move in a vertical plane or a complex terrain.
source_title: Multi-section bionic caterpillar robot and control method thereof

abstract: The invention provides a continuum robot multi-contact-point force sensing device and method based on a fiber bragg grating, the continuum robot multi-contact-point force sensing device comprises a plurality of unit bodies connected in sequence, and any unit body comprises a rigid section and a bendable section; a positioning block is mounted on the rigid section of each unit body, a central cavity channel is formed in the middle of each positioning block, driving cavity channels are formed in the peripheral side of each positioning block, and a plurality of driving cavity channels are formed in the peripheral direction of each positioning block at intervals; a multi-core optical fiber with a plurality of FBG sensors is arranged in the central cavity channel, and a single-core optical fiber engraved with a plurality of FBG sensors is arranged in any driving cavity channel. According to the method, the tension along the whole driving wire is reconstructed by using the FBG sensor, explicit modeling does not need to be carried out on friction between the driving wire and a driving channel, the problems of errors caused by modeling and overlarge computing resource consumption are solved, and the method can be used for simultaneously estimating a plurality of contact points and contact forces on the continuum robot body, so that the accuracy and the reliability of the method are improved. And a great guarantee is provided for safe intervention of the surgical robot.
source_title: Continuous body robot multi-contact-point force sensing device and method based on fiber bragg grating

abstract: The invention discloses a control method, device and equipment of a wheel-legged robot and a readable storage medium and relates to the field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps of acquiring current motion state data of the wheel-legged robot, wherein the current motion state data is used for representing motion characteristics of the wheel-legged robot; inputting the current motion state data into a nonlinear controller to obtain a target joint angular acceleration reference value of a target robot joint of the wheel-legged robot; and the target joint angular acceleration reference value being input into a whole-body dynamics controller, and a joint torque used for controlling the wheel-legged robot to execute a control task being outputted. The control method combining nonlinear control and whole-body dynamics control is adopted, accuracy of balance control over the wheel-legged robot is improved, and smooth control over the wheel-legged robot is also improved.
source_title: Control method, device and equipment of wheel-legged robot and readable storage medium

abstract: The invention provides a series robot and an inverse kinematics solving method thereof, a related medium and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: calculating the current pose of the tail end of the robot according to the current joint angle of the series robot; under the condition that the pose error between the current pose and the target pose is not smaller than the target error, differential inverse kinematics calculation is carried out to obtain the joint speed, and optimization solution is carried out based on the target physical constraint condition to obtain the optimal joint speed; integrating the optimal joint speed to the current joint angle to update the current joint angle until the pose error between the current pose calculated based on the current joint angle and the target pose is smaller than the target error or exceeds the target iteration number; and based on the current joint angle after iteration is finished, motion control is conducted on the series robot. According to the method, through the whole-body optimal control strategy, the inverse kinematics problem is converted into the optimization problem with constraints, the applicability is wide, and joint limitation is not likely to be exceeded.
source_title: Tandem robot, inverse kinematics solving method thereof, related medium and equipment

abstract: System and method for providing remotely guided physical treatment are disclosed. A computing device is communicably coupled to a therapeutic robot and a remote guidance device. The computing device receives full-body images of a treatment subject. The computing device generates a plurality of key physical points for the treatment subject by identifying a three-dimensional human body template that corresponds to the shape and posture parameters of the treatment subject and fitting the identified first three-dimensional human body template to the full-body images of the treatment subject. The fitting causes adjustments to locations of the corresponding set of key physical points of the first three-dimensional human body template. The adjusted locations of the corresponding set of key physical points of the first three-dimensional human body template are provided to the guidance device as basis for a treatment procedure that is specified by the treatment guidance provider during the physical treatment session.
source_title: System and method for generating pressure point maps based on remote-controlled haptic-interactions

abstract: A method and system for exploring a remote environment from an environment simulator at a local base is disclosed. The system includes: at least one proxy robot in the remote environment with at least one near-field and at least one high resolution 360-degree far field video camera; at least one additional device at the remote environment to capture images and data; a transmitter at the remote environment to transmit the video and data to the local base; a terrain analysis computer at the local base to receive and process the video and data to generate a 360-degree approximated real time (ART) video field representing a terrain surrounding the at least one proxy robot; a display in the environment simulator to display the ART video field for at least one user; a full body motion capture suit marked to the dimensions of the at least one user; and a plurality of motion capture video cameras to capture each position change in the motion capture suit, wherein activities performed virtually in the environment simulator represent the identical activities to be performed by the proxy robot in the terrain of the remote environment.
source_title: Replicating the remote environment of a proxy robot

abstract: The invention relates to a delta robot comprising a stationary base (2) and a movable platform (3) that is connected to the base with three chains of links (4,5,6), and comprising a balancing system incorporating at least one pantograph (7) for balancing the robot's center of mass, wherein the at least one pantograph has a first free extremity (10) at which it supports a countermass (13) which is arranged to balance the center of mass of the robot.
source_title: DELTA ROBOT.

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a robot stability control method and device, a model construction method and device and a robot. The robot stability control method comprises the steps that an expected zero moment point and a feedback actual zero moment point of the robot at the current moment are obtained; based on the zero moment point tracking control model, the expected zero moment point and the actual zero moment point, the expected value of the mass center motion state of the robot at the current moment is calculated, and the expected value of the mass center motion state comprises the mass center position correction amount; based on a spring-mass-damping-acceleration model and the expected value of the mass center motion state, calculating the advanced control input quantity of the mass center position correction quantity at the current moment; and controlling the robot to move according to the advanced control input quantity at the current moment and the planned value of the centroid position so as to realize the tracking of the robot on the expected zero moment point. The problem of phase lag between an expected track and an actual track can be effectively solved, and the real-time performance of a robot controller is greatly improved.
source_title: Robot stability control method and device, model construction method and device and robot

abstract: A new controller for use in robots with kinematic loops as well as in most other types of robots (such as those with fully actuated kinematic trees). The controller includes an inverse kinematics (IK) module that implements a versatile IK formulation for retargeting of motions, including expressive motions, onto mechanical systems (i.e., robots with loops and/or without loops). Further, the controller is configured to support the precise control of the position and orientation of end effectors and the center of mass (CoM) (such as of walking robots). The formulation of the algorithms carried out by the IK module safeguards against a disassembly when IK targets are moved outside the workspace of the robot. A regularizer is included in the controller that smoothly circumvents kinematic singularities where velocities go to infinity.
source_title: Robot with an inverse kinematics (IK)-based controller for retargeting input motions

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps of determining an expected zero moment point of the robot; acquiring a left foot position and a right foot position of the robot, and respectively calculating a left foot expected supporting force and a right foot expected supporting force of the robot according to the expected zero moment point, the left foot position and the right foot position; obtaining a left foot measurement supporting force and a right foot measurement supporting force of the robot, and respectively calculating a left leg length variation and a right leg length variation of the robot according to the left foot expected supporting force, the right foot expected supporting force, the left foot measurement supporting force and the right foot measurement supporting force; and controlling the robot to move according to the leg length variation of the left leg and the leg length variation of the right leg. By means of the robot, the robot can keep good stability even in the uneven ground environment.
source_title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a whole-body motion trail optimization method and system for a four-foot single-arm operation robot, and relates to the technical field of four-foot single-arm robot control, and the method comprises the steps: respectively building kinematic models of four limbs and operation arms of a robot and a kinetic model of a trunk mass center; the motion gait of the robot is described through continuous time variables, the motion of the robot is decomposed into trunk mass center motion, leg motion and operation arm motion, motion curves of all the motions are described, and constraint conditions borne by the robot in the motion process are constructed; wherein the time variable is robot phase duration; according to the current state of the robot, a set expected operation target, a kinematics model, a dynamical model, a motion gait, motion curves of various decomposed motions and constraint conditions of robot motion, a whole-body motion track nonlinear optimization problem of robot operation is established, an optimization solution library is adopted for solving the problem, and the whole-body motion track nonlinear optimization problem of robot operation is obtained. And obtaining an optimal motion trail.
source_title: Whole-body motion trail optimization method and system for four-foot single-arm operation robot

abstract: Fast and stable methods are provided for estimating contact forces at multiple contact patches for multi-contact interactions between a robot and objects in its environment. Additionally, the estimated contact forces are physically consistent, and provide a useful to substitute to measured forces using sensors. Embodiments of this invention can be programmed as computer- implemented method(s) into a simulation software to produce smooth motion of the robot and objects in its environment without artifacts such as inter-penetration between bodies and unexpected oscillations.
source_title: GEOMETRIC-COMPOSITION METHOD FOR MULTI-CONTACT RESOLUTION BETWEEN MULTIPLE RIGID OBJECTS

abstract: To plan trajectories of joint angles reaching to the target value by providing only the final target value of the task. A robot control system in accordance with the present invention includes a motion data creation apparatus and the robot. When the motion data creation apparatus searches for trajectory data of a joint angle reaching from an initial posture of the robot to a target posture in a configuration space by using a search technique based on sampling, the motion data creation apparatus calculates a joint angle satisfying an constraint by using a constraint point obtained from a joint angle to be added newly to the trajectory data as an initial value and performing' whole body cooperation calculation such that a difference between a target value of a constraint point specified by the prioritized task and a current value converges.
source_title: ROBOT CONTROL SYSTEM, MOTION DATA CREATION APPARATUS AND ITS CREATING METHOD

abstract: A object pose recognizing method of robot including stereo camera is provided to reduce 3D point cloud data and to cut down the operation time when processing the ICP algorithm by searching the same feature in two images of the same object and by matching the same feature. The object pose recognizing method of robot including stereo camera is as follows. The 3D point cloud data (3D Point Cloud) of the whole body of the recognition object is obtained and is stored at the database(S100). The 3D point cloud data is obtained from the image taken a photograph after the recognition object is taken a picture of by using the stereo camera(S110). With a step for obtaining 3D point group data from the image taken a photograph. The pose of the recognition object material taken a photograph is recognized by matching the 3D point group data of the object whole stored in database with the 3D point group data of the image taken a photograph(S120).
source_title: METHOD FOR OBJECT POSE RECOGNITION OF ROBOT WITH STEREO CAMERA

abstract: The invention discloses a whole-body motion planning and control method for a double-wheel leg-arm robot, provides a multi-task space planning method based on hierarchical optimization aiming at the collaborative motion of a trunk and arms of the double-wheel leg-arm robot and the force output requirement of the tail ends of the arms, and solves the problem of whole-body motion planning redundancy. Wheel leg-trunk-arm force transmission is analyzed based on a two-stage table-trolley model, and arm movement and operation virtual generalized force is incorporated into trunk generalized force planning in a feedforward compensation mode. Left and right wheel leg force distribution characteristics are analyzed, a self-balancing whole-body torque controller based on quadratic programming is provided through construction, nonlinear constraints of all layers are dominated, and therefore the wheel leg torque meeting the whole-body dynamic balance is calculated and obtained. The wheel leg posture generated by applying the torque can keep the double-wheel leg-arm robot at a dynamic balance point, and the dynamic stability of movement operation is improved.
source_title: Whole-body motion planning and control method for double-wheel leg-arm robot

abstract: Embodiments of the present invention are directed to methods of autonomously self-righting a maneuverable robot. In one embodiment, an autonomous method for self-righting a maneuverable robot to affect recovery from an overturned state to its nominal upright configuration may include: defining a convex hull and center of mass of each link of the robot; determining the convex hull and overall robot center of mass for each joint configuration of the robot; analyzing each convex hull face to determine its stability or instability; grouping continuously stable orientations of the robot and joint configurations together defining nodes and transitions there between; assigning a cost to transitions between nodes; computing an overall cost for each potential set of transition costs resulting in achievement of the goal; and determining a sequence of one or more actions to self-right the robot such that the sequence of actions minimizes the overall cost of self-righting the robot.
source_title: Methods for robotic self-righting

abstract: The present technology relates to an information processing device, an information processing method, and a program which enable an object to be grasped stably. The information processing device according to the present technology includes a detecting unit that detects slippage occurring at an object grasped by a grasping unit, and a collaboration control unit that collaboratively controls operations of a whole body of a robot having the grasping portion, in accordance with the slippage of the object. The collaboration control unit controls operations of the configurations making up the whole body of the robot, including at least a manipulator unit to which the grasping portion is attached, and a movement mechanism of the robot. The present technology is applicable to a mobile manipulator that grasps objects.
source_title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD, AND PROGRAM

abstract: The invention provides a mobile mechanical arm cart task planning and control method based on SLAM, the mobile mechanical arm cart task planning and control method comprises the following steps that S1, an environment map is drawn by using SLAM and Yolo, obstacle information is obtained, and real-time path planning is conducted on the environment map by using a navigation function; S2, a cart mobile mechanical arm overall dynamic model with incomplete constraints and complete constraints is established; and S3, a self-adaptive neural network control method based on an integral Lyapunov function is adopted to control a mobile mechanical arm. Aiming at the high nonlinearity and the model uncertainty of a flexible joint robot model, the invention provides a whole body control framework based on Yolo and ORB-SLAM2 so that the mobile mechanical arm can execute operation in an unknown environment, and meanwhile, Yolo obstacle detection, ORB-SLAM2 perception and an integral Lyapunov controller are integrated into the whole body movement operation of the mobile mechanical arm.
source_title: Mobile mechanical arm cart task planning and control method based on SLAM

abstract: A walking robot and a control method in which conversion between walking servo control methods is stably carried out. The walking robot includes a sensor unit to measure angles and torques of joints, and a control unit to calculate voltages applied in a Finite State Machine (FSM) control mode and a Zero Moment Point (ZMP) control mode according to the angles and torques of the joints to drive respective joint motors, to store last target joint angles in the FSM control mode during conversion from the FSM control mode to the ZMP control mode, and to perform a motion based on the FSM control mode by substituting the last target joint angles in the FSM control mode for target joint angles in the FSM control mode during conversion from the ZMP control mode to the FSM control mode, thereby performing stable conversion between walking servo control modes without joint sagging.
source_title: Walking robot and control method thereof

abstract: According to some embodiments of the invention, a tensegrity robot includes a plurality of compressive members, and a plurality of tensile members connected to the compressive members to form a spatially defined structure without the compressive members forming direct load-transmitting connections with each other. Each compressive member has an axial extension with a first axial end and a second axial end and a central axial region. The tensegrity robot also includes a plurality of actuators, each attached to one of the compressive members within a corresponding central axial region thereof. The tensegrity robot also includes a plurality of controllers, each attached to one of the compressive members. Each actuator is operatively connected to a corresponding tensile member so as to selectively change a tension on the tensile member in response to commands from a controllers to thereby change a center of mass of the tensegrity robot to effect movement thereof.
source_title: MODULAR ROD-CENTERED, DISTRIBUTED ACTUATION AND CONTROL ARCHITECTURE FOR SPHERICAL TENSEGRITY ROBOTS

abstract: The invention discloses a quadruped robot control method combined with terrain constraints. The quadruped robot control method comprises the following steps that a quadruped robot single rigid body model is established; simplifying the treading area into a plurality of polygonal areas determined by three-dimensional space lines; a nonlinear model predictive control method is adopted, terrain constraints are added, and the optimal control quantity of expected values of the position, the speed and the acceleration of the joint space of the quadruped robot within a time period is obtained and serves as a first-layer control framework; a whole-body control model of the quadruped robot is established, topographic constraints are introduced, and the optimal control quantity of expected values of the position, the speed and the acceleration of the joint space of the quadruped robot is obtained and serves as a second-layer control architecture; and the first-layer control framework and the second-layer control framework are combined, and the joint torque, meeting the terrain constraint, of the quadruped robot is obtained. According to the method, the form of nonlinear model predictive control is adopted, terrain constraints can be added from the planning level, the foothold of the quadruped robot conforms to dynamic constraints, and the quadruped robot can adapt to complex terrains with high foothold position requirements.
source_title: Quadruped robot control method combined with terrain constraints

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of four-wheel-foot robots, and provides a track optimization and motion generation method, controller and system for a four-wheel-foot robot. The method comprises the steps that a trajectory optimization objective function is constructed based on a motion dynamics model of the four-wheel-foot robot, and the whole-body optimal trajectory of the four-wheel-foot robot in a motion period is solved under the condition that set constraint conditions of the four-wheel-foot robot are met; introducing a virtual joint angle, enabling the world coordinate system to be always aligned with the contact coordinate system through rotation transformation, and constructing a single-wheel-leg kinematics model containing a wheel-ground contact point; and performing inverse kinematics calculation on the single-wheel-leg kinematics model containing the wheel-ground contact points to obtain position information of the wheel legs and the body, and performing motion control on the four-wheel-leg robot in combination with expected foot end contact force.
source_title: Track optimization and motion generation method, controller and system of four-wheel-foot robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot for preventing shoes from rubbing feet, which comprises a driving assembly, a simulated motion assembly and a shell, wherein the driving assembly is fixed in the shell;the driving assembly is provided with a left driving end and a right driving end; the left driving end and the right driving end are respectively connected with the simulated motion assembly; the left driving end and the right driving end are arranged on the outer surface of the shell and are symmetrical to each other; a plurality of simulated feet are arranged on the simulated motion assembly; ashoe tree sleeved with a shoe is arranged on each simulated foot; and the driving assembly drives each simulated foot to simulate the movement of a human body so as to drive the whole body to move towards one direction.
source_title: Robot for preventing shoes from rubbing feet

abstract: An apparatus and a method for robotic control that allows an unbalanced pendulum robot to raise its Center of Mass and balance on two motorized wheels. The robot includes a pair of arms that are connected to the upper body of the robot through motorized joints. The method consists of a series of movements employing the arms of the robot to raise the robot to the upright position. The method comprises a control loop in which the motorized drives are included for dynamic balance of the robot and the control of the arm apparatus. The robot is first configured as a low Center of Mass four-wheeled vehicle, then its Center of Mass is raised using a combination of its wheels and the joint located at the attachment point of the arm apparatus and the robot body, between the rear and front wheels; the method then applies accelerations to the rear wheels to dynamically pivot and further raise the Center of Mass up and over the main drive wheels bringing the robot into a balancing pendulum configuration.
source_title: Reconfigurable balancing robot and method for dynamically transitioning between statically stable mode and dynamically balanced mode

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps that left foot stress information and the right foot stress information of the robot are acquired; a zero moment point of the mass center of the robot is calculated according to the left footstress information and the right foot stress information; an expected carrying output quantity of the robot is calculated according to the zero moment point of the mass center of the body; based on apreset linear inverted pendulum model, a motion trail of the robot is updated according to the expected carrying output quantity to obtain an updated mass center position of the body; inverse kinematics analysis is performed on the updated mass center position of the body to obtain joint angles of the left leg and the right leg of the robot; and the robot is controlled to move according to the joint angles. By means of the robot control method and device, the computer readable storage medium and the robot, it can be guaranteed that the mass center is within the supporting range when the robotcarries an object, and the stability of the robot is greatly improved.
source_title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and in particular relates to a robot attitude control method and device, a computer-readable storage medium, and a robot. The method is used forconstructing a virtual model of the robot; the virtual model comprises a flywheel inverted pendulum model of the robot, and an included angle formed by the foot sole surface of the robot and the horizontal plane; and based on the virtual model, the attitude control of the outer loop closed loop feedback, the inner loop external position disturbance resistance, the inner loop external speed disturbance resistance, and the inner loop external force disturbance resistance is performed on the robot. According to the robot attitude control method, the brand-new virtual model is proposed; on the basis of the flywheel inverted pendulum model of the robot, the included angle between the foot sole surface of the robot and the horizontal plane is considered in the virtual model; and the virtual model can fully reflect the posture of the upper body of the robot, the center of mass and the attitude of foot plates, which are critical elements for the balance and attitude control of the robot; theattitude control is performed based on this virtual model; and the virtual model a relatively good control effect and relatively strong robustness.
source_title: Robot attitude control method and device, readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The embodiment of the invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and relates to a man-machine cooperation system and an operation control method and device.The system comprises a positioner, a robot, a self-adaptive cooperation module and a whole body control module; an end effector of the robot is provided with a force/touch sensor; the force/touch sensor is used for measuring force information applied by the end effector; the positioner is used for measuring motion data of a motion part of the operator; the self-adaptive cooperation module is used for solving the speed control quantity and the pose control quantity of the tail end of the robot based on the motion data and the force information; and the whole body control module is used for solving the joint speed control quantity of the robot based on the speed control quantity and the pose control quantity. According to the technical scheme, the operability of man-machine cooperation for the deformation target object can be improved.
source_title: Man-machine cooperation system, operation control method and device

abstract: The invention provides a method and device for acquiring a centroid trajectory, a robot and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that an optimization variable is constructed according to N centroid variables of the robot in N control periods and the acceleration change rate of N centroids, a coefficient matrix for solving a zero moment point trajectory is obtained according to the optimization variable and a first preset matrix, according to the coefficient matrix for solving the zero moment point trajectory and an expected zero moment point trajectory, an expression matrix of a cost function of the robot is obtained, an equality constraint condition of the centroid of the robot is obtained, and according to the equality constraint condition and the expression matrix of the cost function, constraint solving is carried out on the optimization variable to obtain a centroid trajectory of the robot. According to the method and the device, the optimization variable constraint is solved by adopting the equality constraint condition, so that the cost function constructed by the solved zero moment point trajectory and the expected zero moment point trajectory is minimum, and the centroid trajectory corresponding to the zero moment point track in any shape can be solved.
source_title: Method and device for acquiring centroid trajectory, robot and storage medium

abstract: A system and method is disclosed for predicting a fall of a robot having at least two legs. A learned representation, such as a decision list, generated by a supervised learning algorithm is received. This learned representation may have been generated based on trajectories of a simulated robot when various forces are applied to the simulated robot. The learned representation takes as inputs a plurality of features of the robot and outputs a classification indicating whether the current state of the robot is balanced or falling. A plurality of features of the current state of the robot, such as the height of the center of mass of the robot, are determined based on current values of a joint angle or joint velocity of the robot. The current state of the robot is classified as being either balanced or falling by evaluating the learned representation with the plurality of features of the current state of the robot.
source_title: Machine learning approach for predicting humanoid robot fall

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic flexible driver based on sarcomels, and belongs to the technical field of soft robots. The driver comprises an external pneumatic artificial muscle driving unit group, an internal bionic stretch-draw integral framework, an upper connecting disc buckle group and a lower connecting disc buckle group. The external pneumatic artificial muscle driving unit set is composed of four external pneumatic artificial muscle driving units distributed in a cross shape and serves as an active driving source. The internal tensioning integral framework achieves self-balance and self-stabilization through prestress. Differential air pressure is applied to all the external pneumatic artificial muscle driving units, the external pneumatic artificial muscle driving units are controlled to generate non-uniform axial contraction, and therefore the whole body is driven to achieve controllable bending movement. According to the flexible actuator, the sarcomedo bionic principle and the tensegrity structure are fused, the rigidity and stability are remarkably improved while good flexibility is kept, the problems that a traditional flexible actuator is low in rigidity, slow in response and insufficient in deformation control precision are effectively solved, and the flexible actuator is suitable for robot operation scenes needing high flexibility and environmental adaptability.
source_title: Bionic flexible driver based on sarcomedo

abstract: A walking pattern preparing device for preparing a walking pattern that enables a parallel-link-mechanism, 2-leg walking robot device to go up/down stairs. The walking pattern preparing device for preparing the walking pattern of a 2-leg walking robot device including legs provided with feet and a waist, comprises a path setting means (212) for setting the paths of right and left feet and the initial path of the waist, and target ZMP path setting means (213) for setting the path of a target zero-moment point based on the paths of the feet and the initial path of the waist, wherein the path setting means sets paths such that, when the robot device goes up stairs, the waist is turned so that an idling foot out of the feet is ahead of the other and the idling foot is lifted and allowed to move forward while kept higher, and when it goes down stairs, the waist is turned so that an idling foot out of the feet is ahead of the other and the idling foot is pushed down to a lower level while allowed to move forward.
source_title: WALKING PATTERN PREPARING DEVICE, 2-LEG WALKING ROBOT DEVICE, WALKING PATTERN PREPARING METHOD, 2-LEG WALKING ROBOT DEVICE CONTROLLING METHOD, PROGRAM AND RECORDING MEDIUM

abstract: The invention provides a robot control method and device and a robot. The robot control method provided by the invention comprises the steps of performing global path planning on a mobile chassis in a low-dimensional sampling space according to a starting pose of the mobile chassis at a starting point and a target pose of the mobile chassis at a target point, and obtaining a collision-free path of the mobile chassis from the starting point to the target point; the initial pose of the mechanical arm is added to each path point on the collision-free path, and a global whole-body path of the robot is obtained; determining a target path section to be replanned; for the target path section, according to the starting pose of the robot at the starting point of the target path section and the ending pose of the robot at the ending point of the target path section, global path planning is conducted on the robot in the high-dimensional sampling space, and a preferred path of the robot from the starting point to the ending point is obtained; and replacing the target path section by using an optimal path to obtain an optimized global whole-body collision-free path, and controlling the robot by using the global whole-body collision-free path.
source_title: Robot control method and device and robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps that in the process that a robot carries a load, foot trajectory planning is conducted on the robot, and a foot trajectory planning result of the robot is obtained; determining a zero moment point reference trajectory of the robot according to the foot trajectory planning result; determining an equivalent centroid trajectory according to the zero moment point reference trajectory; wherein the equivalent center of mass is the center of mass which takes the robot and the load as a whole; the mass center track of the robot is determined according to the equivalent mass center track; inverse kinematics solution is conducted according to the mass center track of the robot, and the leg joint poses of the robot are obtained; and controlling the robot to move according to the leg joint poses of the robot. According to the method, the influence generated by the load is fully considered, and the walking stability of the robot is effectively improved.
source_title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot

abstract: A robot controller controls a robot during a fall to reduce the damage to the robot upon impact. The robot controller causes the robot to achieve a tripod-like posture having three contact points (e.g., two hands and one foot) so that the robot motion in arrested with its center of mass (CoM) high above the ground. This prevents a large impact caused by the transfer of potential energy to kinetic energy during the fall. The optimal locations of the three contacts are learned through a machine learning algorithm.
source_title: Humanoid fall damage reduction

abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technology for calculating a center-of-gravity track where a ZMP (zero moment point) coincides with a target ZMP even if taking a sinking action in a one-leg grounding phase.

SOLUTION: The legged robot changing the center of gravity into a vertical direction while one leg link is grounded by changing a joint angle, is provided with a means for generating the vertical track of the center of gravity; a means for calculating the horizontal track of the center of gravity based on the generated vertical track of the center of gravity, a trinominal equation obtained by discretizing a ZMP equation, the target ZMP and the horizontal speed of the center of gravity at the start and completion of the vertical track; a means for calculating age-based data of the target value of the joint angle based on the generated vertical track of the center of gravity and the calculated horizontal track of the center of gravity; and a means for rotating a joint based on the calculated age-based data of the target value of the joint angle.
