source_title: LEGGED ROBOT AND ITS CONTROL METHOD

abstract: PURPOSE: A leg stopper for a robot and a controlling method for the same are provided to stably position a robot by extending a stopper for supporting the robot and to restore to a normal operation. CONSTITUTION: A leg stopper for a robot comprises a stopper device(500), a sensor unit(300), and a control unit. The stopper device is drew from or inserted into a robot foot(F) through a plurality of directions. The sensor unit comprises a plurality of FSR(Force Sensing Resistor)s installed on a robot sole for measuring the load distribution of an area where the robot foot touches the ground. The control unit controls the stopper device by comparing a stable area where the robot foot touches the ground and the position of a ZMP(Zero Moment Point).
source_title: LEG STOPPER FOR ROBOT AND METHOD FOR CON TROLING THE SAME

abstract: The invention provides a multi-module security device and a robot, and relates to the field of security equipment. The problems that most elements of a security system are independently arranged and are difficult to integrate reasonably at present are solved. A magic cube type structure is formed by splicing a plurality of modules, security parts are arranged on side modules and a center module, the relative positions of the security parts are adjusted through rotation of the side modules and the center module around the center of a whole body, and the orientations of the security parts are adjusted according to needs. The multi-module security device comprises a machine frame, corner modules, the side modules and the center module, the magic cube type structure is formed, the sides, facing the outside, of the side modules and the center module are provided with grooves provided with the security parts, three driving mechanisms are arranged in each corner module, the output ends of the three driving mechanisms are attached to the side walls of the three side modules adjacent to the corner module respectively, and the driving mechanisms can drive the modules of the layer or column corresponding to the contacted side module to rotate around the center of a frame.
source_title: Multi-module security device and robot

abstract: According to the present invention, a force measurement system for controlling a posture of a walking robot comprises: a load cell sensor mounted on a foot of a walking robot to measure vertical load by weight of the walking robot during walking of the walking robot; a load end bearing connected to the load cell sensor and removing rotation moment applied to the load cell sensor except the vertical load; and a control unit measuring landing power of the walking robot from data measured by the load cell sensor and calculating a ZMP (zero moment point).
source_title: FORCE MEASUREMENT SYSTEM FOR ATTITUDE CONTROL OF WALKING ROBOT

abstract: The invention discloses an ankle and foot mechanism for a running and jumping double-foot robot. The ankle and foot mechanism for the running and jumping double-foot robot consists of an ankle joint transmission mechanism and a pelma force detecting mechanism, wherein the ankle joint transmission mechanism comprises an ankle joint motor, a crank, a connecting rod, a shank, an ankle joint rotatingshaft, a sole and a connecting rod shaft; and the pelma force detecting mechanism comprises a first force sensor, a second force sensor, a pelma pad, a heel, a front sole, a guiding column sleeve andfive guiding columns. By the design of a four-bar linkage, the ankle joint motor controls the angle or angular velocity of an ankle joint, by the transmission mechanism, the center of mass of the ankle or shank is raised to a high position, the rotational inertia of the shank is greatly reduced, furthermore, the space of the ankle is saved, the size of feet is reduced, the weight is also reduced,the dynamic response characteristic of whole legs in a swinging process is improved favorably, and the flexibility of movement of the robot is improved.
source_title: Ankle and foot mechanism for running and jumping double-foot robot

abstract: The invention discloses a complex irregular-shaped workpiece flexible assembly method based on machine vision, and belongs to the technical field of robot assembly. Comprising the following steps: acquiring a 3D point cloud of an assembly workpiece, and obtaining a contour of the 3D point cloud as a template contour of the assembly workpiece; acquiring an RGB-D image of the assembly base based on the depth camera, extracting the contour of an assembly hole of the assembly base by using Canny edge detection, and calculating the position of the center of mass of the assembly hole; a double-stage contour registration method is adopted, the contour of the base assembly hole is matched with the contour of a template of an assembly workpiece, and pre-positioning of the assembly workpiece is achieved; and the assembly robot inserts the assembly workpiece according to the pre-positioned posture and the admittance algorithm through the force signal collected by the force sensor until the assembly is completed. According to the method, visual geometric guidance and a force sense accurate perception model are combined, and flexible assembly of workpieces in complex shapes is achieved according to an admittance control algorithm. The method is high in efficiency and good in safety, and provides reliable technical support for industrial scene application.
source_title: Complex irregular-shaped workpiece flexible assembly method based on machine vision

abstract: The present invention relates to a robot (1) capable of moving on the ground by means of a spherical wheel (2) suitable for rolling on the ground, the robot (1) comprising a trunk (4), at least one arm (5) and an upper part (6), the trunk (4) being connected to the platform (3) and to the upper part (6), characterised in that the robot (1) can move by tilting between a straight position and a tilted position, the trunk (4) of the robot (1) comprising a first portion (40) and a second portion (41), the trunk (4) being configured to maintain the position of the centre of mass (7) of the robot (1) so as to allow the robot (1) to tilt towards the ground.
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT HAVING A SPHERICAL WHEEL AND COMPRISING AN ARTICULATED TRUNK

abstract: The invention relates to a high-precision stable control method based on a fire-fighting robot. The method comprises the steps: carrying out decoupling of a mass center and angular momentum of a robot system based on a zero moment point extension method, kinematics and dynamics models, and obtaining a three-dimensional linear model for global dynamic optimization control; based on an overall kinetic model and a kinematic model of the robot system and a boundary stability condition model during cooperative action of a robot platform, constructing a stability criterion of a robot under a specific load working condition, a working environment and a motion track for judging reasonability of a remote control instruction; and analyzing the stability of the robot under a specific remote control instruction in real time according to environmental perception information and information of a robot platform pose part in combination with the boundary stability condition model, and obtaining a reasonable correction strategy of the remote control instruction. According to the stable operation control method based on the fire-fighting robot in an unsteady state environment, boundary stable conditions are constructed, and stable operation of the rescue robot in the complex environment is achieved.
source_title: High-precision stable control method based on fire-fighting robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a search and rescue method through whole body control of a snake-shaped robot based on weight change. The snake-shaped robot according to an aspect of the present invention includes a body part to which a plurality of modules are connected. Based on a change of at least one of a connection point and a separation distance between the plurality of modules, at least one of the length and shape of the body part is changeable. The weight of at least some of the plurality of modules is variable. A predetermined task may be performed based on the changed length of the body part, the changed shape of the body part, and the changed weight of the at least one module.
source_title: Searching and Rescue Method through Snake Robot Whole Body Control Based on Weight Change

abstract: A robot control method includes: obtaining force information associated with a left foot and a right foot of the robot; calculating a zero moment point of a COM of a body of the robot based on the force information; updating a motion trajectory of the robot according to the zero moment point of the COM of the body to obtain an updated position of the COM of the body; performing inverse kinematics analysis on the updated position of the COM of the body to obtain joint angles of a left leg and a right leg of the robot; and controlling the robot to move according to the joint angles.
source_title: Robot control method, computer-readable storage medium and robot

abstract: The invention discloses a robot with bionic muscles, and the robot comprises a robot body which comprises a static fitting area, a movable joint area and a rigid support; the static attaching area is filled with a first composite material composed of a flexible memory telescopic material with a first thickness and an elastic fabric, and the elastic fabric is in filling connection with the static attaching area of the robot body by wrapping the flexible memory telescopic material with the first thickness; a second composite material composed of a flexible memory telescopic material with a second thickness and an elastic fabric is attached to the movable joint area, and the flexible memory telescopic material with the second thickness wraps the movable joint area of the robot body through quilting elastic fabric on the inner side and the outer side. The technical problems that interaction actions and touch feeling with people are stiff, the fineness and flexibility of completing emotion interaction actions are insufficient, and whole-body muscle touch feeling simulation is insufficient are solved.
source_title: Robot with bionic muscles

abstract: The invention discloses a method for a robot to realize whole body compliance by processing a large-area tactile signal, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a tactile signal through a large-area tactile skin array covering the surface of a multi-degree-of-freedom mobile robot, processing and simplifying the signal, and enabling the processed and simplified signal to be equivalent to a six-dimensional resultant force/torque of single-point contact; a separate calculation of the force/moment of each haptic sensing unit is avoided. The resultant force is mapped to all joints of the robot to obtain the joint external torque, then the motion instruction when the robot is stressed is obtained through the assumed robot virtual dynamical model, the whole body compliance behavior of the robot coping with the external force is achieved, and large-range and safe man-machine physical interaction is further achieved.
source_title: Method for achieving whole body compliance by processing large-area tactile signals through robot

abstract: The invention discloses a modular snakelike rescue robot and a control system thereof, and relates to the technical field of snakelike rescue robots, the snakelike rescue robot is formed by connecting six joints in series, each joint has two degrees of freedom, and the snakelike rescue robot has twelve degrees of freedom; each joint assembly is composed of a driving component, a frame connecting piece, a transmission component, a transmission supporting piece, a supporting connecting shaft piece and a joint connecting assembly, and the joint assemblies work cooperatively to enable the joints to achieve two independent rotation freedom degrees. Through the design of high redundancy, the robot has excellent adaptive capacity and lower center of mass, the problem that a traditional robot is difficult to effectively operate in the environment due to huge structure and weight and limited maneuverability and flexibility is solved, and the robot is suitable for detection application in rugged road conditions or narrow spaces.
source_title: Modularized snakelike rescue robot and control system thereof

abstract: A legged mobile robot (R), a legged mobile robot controller (1) and a legged mobile robot control method are provided to perform a loading operation to load a gripped object in parallel on a target place having a height where a stretchable range of arm portions of the legged mobile robot is enhanced with no operator's handling. The legged mobile robot (R) includes the arm portions (R3) having links for gripping an object, and leg portions (R1) having links for moving, and the arm portions (R3) and the leg portions (R1) are joined to a body R2 thereof. The legged mobile robot controller (1) includes a data acquisition unit (3), a whole-body cooperative motion control unit (5) and a loading detection unit (7), and controls motions of the legged mobile robot (R) based on posture/position data regarding a posture/position of each link of the legged mobile robot (R) and on an external force data regarding an external force affecting the arm portions (R3).
source_title: Legged mobile robot and its controller and control method

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of exoskeleton robots, and discloses an exoskeleton robot assisting in operating a high-voltage chamber handcart circuit breaker, the exoskeleton robot comprises a trunk fixing structure, two arm assemblies and two operating parts, the two arm assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the outer side of the trunk fixing structure, and the trunk fixing structure comprises a waist and hip bandage and a strap; the arm assembly comprises a supporting rod, a large arm connecting rod and a small arm connecting rod, the lower end of the supporting rod is hinged to the waist and hip bandage, and the operation part is arranged at the end of the small arm connecting rod. The operation part comprises a wrist support and an operation piece, the operation piece is integrated with a rotating end and a push-pull end, the rotating end or the push-pull end can be adjusted to the position facing the handcart circuit breaker, and the auxiliary requirements for different maintenance operations are met. The supporting rod, the large arm connecting rod and the small arm connecting rod form a three-section hinged mode, the improvement purpose of common power generation of the whole body is achieved through cooperative power assistance of the three driving pieces of the waist hip, the shoulder and the elbow, and the effective auxiliary effect is achieved for the operation task of the high-voltage chamber handcart circuit breaker.
source_title: Exoskeleton robot for assisting operation of high-voltage chamber handcart circuit breaker

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-legged robot whole-body motion control system and method considering slippage steering, and relates to the technical field of wheel-legged machine control. The system comprises an input module used for receiving an expected motion track or a motion instruction from an upper layer planning system; the trajectory optimization module takes the motion trajectory output by the input module as a tracking target, so that the platform can be optimized in real time along an offline trajectory; the tracking control module is used for solving a joint torque through inverse dynamics by adopting a total rigid body dynamic model, realizing motion tracking through a whole body control WBC method, and solving a motion and contact force priority task by using a hierarchical optimization method; and the state estimation module is used for estimating all current state quantities of model predictive control MPC and information required by whole body control WBC through sensor information. By means of the system, high-dynamic stable motion control over the wheel-legged robot under the complex terrain can be achieved.
source_title: Wheel-legged robot whole-body motion control system and method considering slippage steering

abstract: A method for controlling walking of a robot includes: determining a stance of the robot, in response to the robot being in a single-leg stance, determining a rotational angle of each of the joints, and calculating a value of a torque produced by a force of gravity acting on the robot about each of the joints; in response to the robot being in a double-leg stance, calculating a position of a projection of a center of mass of the robot on a surface where the robot stands, and calculating a value of a torque produced by a force of gravity acting on the robot about each of the joints according to the position of the projection; obtaining a feed-forward current of each of the joints; and applying the feed-forward current of each of the joints to a corresponding actuator of this joints.
source_title: Method for controlling walking of robot and robot

abstract: In order to solve the problems that high-altitude operation of building supporting components and trees is difficult, equipment climbing is limited and the like, the invention provides a light double-hand clamping type climbing robot which comprises a clamping manipulator, a rotating mechanism and two supporting arms. The clamping manipulator is composed of a square frame, a four-point clamping mechanism and a single-point clamping mechanism, the clamping mechanisms on the two sides simulate finger bending, the number of wedge-shaped blocks can be adjusted according to different working requirements to change the bending degree, and the four-point clamping mechanism is composed of a quick-release frame and four clamping units and is designed to be a multi-contact clamping face; the single-point clamping mechanism is composed of a quick-release frame and a clamping unit and is designed to be a single-contact clamping face. The two are driven by a motor gear on a square motor and a worm in a matched mode, the automatic locking function is achieved, and the clamping reliability is improved; the rotating mechanism is connected with the square frame and the supporting arm, free rotation of the clamping mechanical arm can be achieved in the climbing process, the climbing capacity is improved, and the climbing robot can move in multiple directions. The double supporting arms are composed of driving mechanisms and hollow frames, turnover type climbing or peristaltic type climbing can be selected according to task requirements and environmental conditions, turnover type climbing is flexible to adapt to different heights and angles, and the climbing efficiency is high; peristaltic climbing simulates biological movement, and stable movement of a complex surface is ensured.
source_title: Light double-hand clamping type climbing robot for columnar object

abstract: A method (1400) of operating a robot (100) includes driving the robot to approach a reach point, extending a manipulator arm (600) forward of the reach point, and maintaining a drive wheel (500) and a center of mass of the robot rearward of the reach point by moving a counter-balance body (300) relative to an inverted pendulum body (200) while extending the manipulator arm forward of the reach point. The robot includes the inverted pendulum body, the counter-balance body deposed on the inverted pendulum body, the manipulator arm connected to the inverted pendulum body, at least one leg (400) having a first end (410) prismatically coupled to the inverted pendulum body, and the drive wheel rotatably coupled to a second end (420) of the at least one leg.
source_title: REACHING MOBILE ROBOTS

abstract: The invention relates to a robot motion control method and device, a robot, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: in response to a motion command, acquiring expected motion information of the robot; acquiring real-time state information of the robot; according to the expected motion information and the real-time state information, control information of the foot ends and control information of whole-body dynamics are determined; and controlling the robot to move according to the control information of the foot ends and the control information of the whole-body dynamics. By adopting the method, the motion control can be more accurately carried out.
source_title: Robot motion control method and device, robot, readable storage medium and program product

abstract: Robotics platforms in accordance with various embodiments of the invention can be utilized to implement highly dexterous robots capable of whole body motion. Robotics platforms in accordance with one embodiment of the invention include: a memory containing a whole body motion application; a spine, where the spine has seven degrees of freedom and comprises a spine actuator and three spine elbow joints that each include two spine joint actuators; at least one limb, where the at least one limb comprises a limb actuator and three limb elbow joints that each include two limb joint actuators; a tracked base; a connecting structure that connects the at least one limb to the spine; a second connecting structure that connects the spine to the tracked base; wherein the processor is configured by the whole body motion application to move the at least one limb and the spine to perform whole body motion.
source_title: Surrogate: a body-dexterous mobile manipulation robot with a tracked base

abstract: A system providing dynamic balancing in a robotic system. The system includes memory storing a definition of a robot and storing an input animation for the robot specifying motion of components of the robot. A simulator performs a dynamic simulation of the robot performing the input animation including modeling a first set of the components as flexible components and a second set of the components as rigid components. Each of the flexible components is coupled at opposite ends to one of the rigid components. An optimizer generates a retargeted motion for the components to provide dynamic balancing of the robot performing the retargeted motion. The optimizer generates the retargeted motion by transforming forces acting on the robot to a local contact frame rigidly moving with the robot. The optimizer generates the retargeted motion so a zero-moment point of the robot lies in a support area of the robot's feet.
source_title: VIBRATION SUPPRESSION AND DYNAMIC BALANCING FOR RETARGETING MOTIONS ONTO ROBOTIC SYSTEMS

abstract: A legged robot that can ensure a large step length while keeping the height of a body trunk at a low position without increasing a moment that is generated due to the gravitational force acting on the trunk and acting on roll joints of legs when standing on one leg is realized. In the legged robot (100), a pair of legs (20R, 20L) is connected so as to be able to rotate around a pitch axis (Y-axis) at lateral surfaces (12) of a trunk (10). Thereby, it is possible to make the height H1 high while keeping the height of the trunk (10) low. It is possible to ensure a large step length while keeping the height of the trunk (10) at a low position. Legs (20) have a structure in which roll joints (38, 42) are positioned below a bottom surface (14). Thereby, the length L1 in the pitch axis direction between the rotation axis C1 of these joints and the center of mass G of the trunk is limited. The moment acting on the roll joints of the grounding leg when standing on one leg is not increased.
source_title: LEGGED ROBOT

abstract: The invention relates to a method and a computing system for estimating robot operating parameters. A computing system and a method for estimating friction and/or center of mass (CoM) is presented. The system may perform the method by selecting at least one of (i) a first joint of the plurality of joints, or (ii) a first arm section of the plurality of arm sections. The computing system also outputs a set of one or more movement commands for causing movement of the robotic arm, the movement includes relative movement between the first arm section and the second arm section via the first joint, and receives a set of actuation data and a set of movement data associated with the first joint or the first arm section. The computing system also determines at least one of (i) a friction parameter estimate or (ii) a CoM estimate based on the set of actuation data and the set of movement data.
source_title: Method and computing system for estimating robot operating parameters

abstract: A method (1400) of maneuvering a robot (100) includes driving the robot across a surface (12) and turning the robot by shifting a center of mass of the robot toward a turning direction, thereby leaning the robot into the turning direction. The robot includes an inverted pendulum body (200), a counter-balance body (300) disposed on the inverted pendulum body and configured to move relative to the inverted pendulum body, at least one leg (400) prismatically coupled to the inverted pendulum body, and a drive wheel (500) rotatably coupled to the at least one leg. The inverted pendulum body has first and second end portions (210, 220) and defines a forward drive direction. The method also includes turning the robot by at least one of moving the counter-balance body relative to the inverted pendulum body or altering a height of the at least one leg with respect to the surface.
source_title: MANEUVERING MOBILE ROBOTS

abstract: The invention provides a robot control method and device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a whole-body angular momentum matrix of the robot at the current moment; according to the whole-body angular momentum matrix of the robot at the current moment, a robot inverse solution function is constructed, the robot inverse solution function comprises a joint speed cost function, and the joint speed cost function is used for indicating that the generalized speed of the robot at the current moment is smaller than a joint speed threshold value; according to the inverse solution function, the generalized position and the generalized speed of the robot at the current moment are obtained through calculation; according to the generalized position and the generalized speed of the robot at the current moment, motion control is conducted on the robot, by applying the method, the phenomenon that the generalized speed of the robot at any moment is infinite can be avoided through the joint speed cost function, and therefore the robustness of the robot control method can be improved, and compliant control over the robot is achieved.
source_title: Robot control method and device and storage medium

abstract: The invention discloses a force traction gravity compensation method for an initial value of a force sensor. The force traction gravity compensation method comprises the following steps that multiple groups of six-dimensional force sensor measurement data are obtained when an end execution tool is not subjected to external force and a robot is in different postures; an equation set is established for a fixed value according to the measurement data of the six-dimensional force sensor under different attitudes, an optimal value is solved by using a least square method, and an initial value parameter of the six-dimensional force sensor is solved; according to the initial value parameter of the six-dimensional force sensor, the gravity of the end execution tool, the coordinate of the center of mass of the end execution tool in the six-dimensional force sensor and the initial torque value of the six-dimensional force sensor are obtained; pose transformation of the six-dimensional force sensor coordinate system relative to the robot base coordinate system is solved; and the force and the torque applied to the six-dimensional force sensor by the outside are solved. The force traction gravity compensation method for the initial value of the force sensor is used for effectively performing parameter estimation on tool gravity and realizing tool gravity compensation.
source_title: Force traction gravity compensation method for initial value of force sensor

abstract: The invention discloses a 5-connecting-rod exoskeleton robot squat and rise process stability control method. The method comprises the following steps of step1, giving an expected position of a center of mass and a ZMP position; step2, calculating actual values of the position of the center of mass and the ZMP position respectively; step3, calculating a position error Eercom of the center of mass; step4, when ||Eercom|| is greater than or equal to ||Eerzmp||, executing a step5, and when the ||Eercom|| is less than ||Eerzmp||, returning to the step1; and step5, calculating a correction vector delta q of a joint angle. By using the 5-connecting-rod exoskeleton robot squat and rise process stability control method, a mathematical relationship between the ZMP and the COM (the center of mass) is used to calculate an actual zero point moment so as to acquire a deviation value of the center of mass and a zero moment point; and according to the deviation value, a squat and rise track is optimized and controlled and a deviation is corrected so as to realize stable operation of exoskeleton robot squat and rise motion. A control mode in the invention is simple and high-efficient and is easy to realize.
source_title: 5-connecting-rod exoskeleton robot squat and rise process stability control method

abstract: A robot is provided with a motion control unit. The motion control unit of the robot comprises - a distance computing module calculating the two closest points of different segments of the robot connected to each other via at least one joint, or a segment of the robot and another object, and outputting - a whole body control module, - a collision avoidance module supplied with an output signal from the distance computing module, - a blending control unit for combining the weighted output control signals of the whole body control module and the collision avoidance control module, wherein the weight of the whole body control output signal is the higher the lower a calculated collision risk, and wherein the weight of the collision avoidance control output signal is the higher the higher the calculated collision risk. The collision avoidance module is designed for - calculating the two closest points of different segments of the robot connected to each other via at least one joint, or a segment of the robot and another object, and - controlling a collision avoidance action only in the dimension along the connection line between the closest points.
source_title: Robots with collision avoidance functionality

abstract: A service robot includes a wheeled, robotic vehicle and a movable payload platform. A position of the payload platform is controlled to reduce the distance between the center of mass of the service robot and a center of rotation of the vehicle moving along a motion trajectory. Induced centrifugal forces are reduced, allowing for safe operation at higher speeds. In some examples, the payload platform is moved such that the center of mass of the service robot is approximately aligned with the center of rotation of the vehicle. In some embodiments, at least one wheel of the service robot is controlled to maintain a level orientation of the service robot as it traverses uneven terrain. In some embodiments, the service robot includes an inflatable torso structure that allows an upper body robot to bend in a controlled manner to interact with users and a payload loaded onto the payload platform.
source_title: Service robot having movable center of mass

abstract: A method (1400) of operating a robot (100) includes assuming a resting pose (PR) of the robot on a surface (12). The robot includes an inverted pendulum body (200), a counter-balance body (300) disposed on the inverted pendulum body and configured to move relative to the inverted pendulum body, at least one arm (600) connected to the inverted pendulum body and configured to move relative to the inverted pendulum body, at least one leg (400) prismatically coupled to the inverted pendulum body, and a drive wheel (500) rotatably coupled to the at least one leg. The method also includes moving from the resting pose to a sitting pose (PSit) by moving the counter-balance body relative to the inverted pendulum body away from the ground surface to position a center of mass of the robot substantially over the drive wheel.
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT SITTING AND STANDING
